/-- **Equation (3.1).** `d̃ = p^N + ∑_{j<N} p^j a_j` with `a_j ∈ C` and
`deg_B a_j ≤ N - j`. -/
def IsMonicNormalForm {n : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : ℕ → PresentedWeyl k (n + 1),
    (∀ j < N, a j ∈ C k n ∧ bernsteinDegree k (a j) ≤ N - j) ∧
      dt = p k n ^ N + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, p k n ^ j * a j

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.doc:
**Proposition 3.2.** Let `0 ≠ d ∈ A_n(k)` with `N := deg_B d ≥ 1`.  There
are an automorphism `Φ_g` of `A_n(k)` and `c ∈ k^×` with
`d̃ := c⁻¹ Φ_g(d) = p^N + ∑_{j<N} p^j a_j`, `a_j ∈ C`, `deg_B a_j ≤ N - j`
(eq. (3.1)), and `deg_B d̃ = N`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_2.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] {n : ℕ}
  {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hd : d ≠ 0)
  (hN : 1 ≤ bernsteinDegree k d) :
  ∃ g c,
    c ≠ 0 ∧
      IsMonicNormalForm k (bernsteinDegree k d) (c⁻¹ • (phiG k g) d) ∧
        bernsteinDegree k (c⁻¹ • (phiG k g) d) = bernsteinDegree k d
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.source:
/-- **Proposition 3.2.** Let `0 ≠ d ∈ A_n(k)` with `N := deg_B d ≥ 1`.  There
are an automorphism `Φ_g` of `A_n(k)` and `c ∈ k^×` with
`d̃ := c⁻¹ Φ_g(d) = p^N + ∑_{j<N} p^j a_j`, `a_j ∈ C`, `deg_B a_j ≤ N - j`
(eq. (3.1)), and `deg_B d̃ = N`. -/
theorem proposition_3_2 [CharZero k] {n : ℕ} {d : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hN : 1 ≤ bernsteinDegree k d) :
    ∃ (g : Matrix.symplecticGroup (Fin (n + 1)) k) (c : k), c ≠ 0 ∧
      IsMonicNormalForm k (bernsteinDegree k d) (c⁻¹ • phiG k g d) ∧
      bernsteinDegree k (c⁻¹ • phiG k g d) = bernsteinDegree k d := by
  obtain ⟨hpiece, hne, hhom, -, -⟩ := bernsteinSymbol_ne_zero k hd
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := step_3_2_nonvanishing k hhom hne hN
  obtain ⟨h, hpres, hhe⟩ := step_3_2_h k hv0 (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1)))
  obtain ⟨g, -, hmul⟩ := step_3_2_transpose k h hpres
  obtain ⟨hpiece', heval, hdeg'⟩ := step_3_2_symbol k g hpiece (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1)))
  rw [hmul, hhe] at heval hdeg'
  obtain ⟨hpiece'', hdeg'', hval⟩ := step_3_2_normalize k hpiece' (hdeg' hv) _ hv heval
  exact ⟨g, _, hv, step_3_2_monic k hpiece'' hval, hdeg''⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.doc:
**Proposition 3.6.** Equip `Q` with the order filtration `Q_m = qF_m`
induced by the cyclic generator `q = [1]`, and write `P = σ_N^ord(d̃)`.  Then
`P ∈ Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q` (eq. (3.5)).
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_6.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] {n N : ℕ}
  {dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt)
  (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
  orderSymbol k N dt ∈ Module.annihilator (Characteristic.SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt)
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.source:
/-- **Proposition 3.6.** Equip `Q` with the order filtration `Q_m = qF_m`
induced by the cyclic generator `q = [1]`, and write `P = σ_N^ord(d̃)`.  Then
`P ∈ Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q` (eq. (3.5)). -/
theorem proposition_3_6 {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
    orderSymbol k N dt ∈ Module.annihilator (SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hF, -⟩, -⟩ := lemma_3_5 k hform hdeg
  rw [Module.mem_annihilator]
  intro m
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (step_3_6_generated k dt).2.2 m
  rw [smul_comm, step_3_6_kills k hF, smul_zero]

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.closure_transverseCoordinateAlgebra_momentum.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k]
  (n : ℕ) [Algebra ℚ k] :
  Subring.closure
      (↑(transverseCoordinateAlgebra k n) ∪ {WeylIteratedEquivalence.presentedMomentum k n}) =
    ⊤
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.closure_transv.source:
/-- `C` and `p` together generate `A_n`. -/
theorem closure_transverseCoordinateAlgebra_momentum [Algebra ℚ k] :
    Subring.closure ((transverseCoordinateAlgebra k n : Set (PresentedWeyl k (n + 1))) ∪
      {presentedMomentum k n}) = ⊤ := by
  apply top_unique
  intro z _
  have hz : presentedToIterated k (n + 1) z ∈
      (⊤ : Subring (PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n))) := trivial
  let := Stafford38.WeylEulerRemainder.iteratedRatAlgebra k n
  rw [← closure_pairOldSubring_union_coordinate_momentum_eq_top] at hz
  have hle : Subring.closure (((pairOldSubring (IteratedPairStage k n) :
        Subring (PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n))) : Set _) ∪
        {pairCoordinate, pairMomentum}) ≤
      (Subring.closure ((transverseCoordinateAlgebra k n : Set (PresentedWeyl k (n + 1))) ∪
        {presentedMomentum k n})).comap (fromIterated k n) := by
    apply Subring.closure_le.2
    rintro a (⟨b, rfl⟩ | ha)
    · exact Subring.subset_closure (Or.inl (Subring.subset_closure
        (Or.inl (fromIterated_coefficient_mem_transverse k n b))))
    · simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl
      · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subring.mem_comap, fromIterated_coordinate]
        exact Subring.subset_closure (Or.inl (Subring.subset_closure (Or.inr rfl)))
      · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subring.mem_comap, fromIterated_momentum]
        exact Subring.subset_closure (Or.inr rfl)
  have h : fromIterated k n (presentedToIterated k (n + 1) z) ∈
      Subring.closure ((transverseCoordinateAlgebra k n : Set (PresentedWeyl k (n + 1))) ∪
        {presentedMomentum k n}) := Subring.mem_comap.mp (hle hz)
  rwa [fromIterated_toIterated] at h
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.closure_transv.unfolded:
∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] (n : ℕ) [Algebra ℚ k],
  Subring.closure
      (↑(Subring.closure
            (↑((RingQuot.liftAlgHom k)
                      ⟨(FreeAlgebra.lift k) fun i =>
                          (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                              ∃ i j,
                                a =
                                    FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                      FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                                  b =
                                    (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                      (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                            (FreeAlgebra.ι k
                              (Sum.casesOn i (fun val => Sum.inl val.succ) fun val =>
                                Sum.inr val.succ)),
                        ⋯⟩).range.toSubring ∪
              {(RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                    ∃ i j,
                      a =
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                        b =
                          (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                            (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                  (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl 0))})) ∪
        {(RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
              ∃ i j,
                a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                  b =
                    (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                      (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
            (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr 0))}) =
    ⊤

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.doc:
**Corollary 4.11.** Multiplication by `x₁` on `gr Q` is surjective, i.e.
`gr Q = (gr Q) x₁`, for `d̃` in the form (3.1) with `N ≥ 1`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [CharZero k] [Algebra ℚ k]
  {n N : ℕ} {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hN : 0 < N)
  (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) : Function.Surjective fun z => symbolCoordinate k n • z
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.source:
/-- **Corollary 4.11.** Multiplication by `x₁` on `gr Q` is surjective, i.e.
`gr Q = (gr Q) x₁`, for `d̃` in the form (3.1) with `N ≥ 1`. -/
theorem corollary_4_11 (hN : 0 < N) (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
    Function.Surjective (fun z : GrQ k n N d => symbolCoordinate k n • z) := by
  have hU := step_4_11_cokernel_zero hN hform
  have htop : LinearMap.range (coordinateMap k n N d) = ⊤ :=
    Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mp hU
  intro z
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp htop z
  exact ⟨w, (setup_coordinateMap_apply k n N d w).symm.trans hw⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11_quotSMulTop.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [CharZero k]

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.source:
/-- Corollary 4.11 in the form `M/x₁M = 0` over `k[x,ξ]` (`QuotSMulTop`), as
consumed by the support-avoidance argument of Section 6. -/
theorem corollary_4_11_quotSMulTop (hN : 0 < N)
    (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
    Subsingleton (QuotSMulTop (symbolCoordinate k n) (GrQ k n N d)) := by
  have hsurj := corollary_4_11 hN hform
  change Subsingleton (GrQ k n N d ⧸ symbolCoordinate k n • (⊤ : Submodule (Symbol k n) _))
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff, eq_top_iff]
  intro z _
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hsurj z
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul w _ ⊤ trivial

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_4.doc:
**Definition 4.4 (localization).**  Mathlib's `Localization S` and
`LocalizedModule S N` are the rings and modules of fractions with
`a/s = a'/s' ↔ t(s'a − sa') = 0` and `y/s = y'/s' ↔ t(s'y − sy') = 0` for some
`t ∈ S`, and localization is exact.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_4.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_4.{v, u_1} {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (S : Submonoid R)
  {N : Type v} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] :
  (∀ (a a' : R) (s s' : ↥S),
      Localization.mk a s = Localization.mk a' s' ↔ ∃ t, ↑t * (↑s' * a - ↑s * a') = 0) ∧
    (∀ (y y' : N) (s s' : ↥S),
        LocalizedModule.mk y s = LocalizedModule.mk y' s' ↔ ∃ t, t • (s' • y - s • y') = 0) ∧
      ∀ {N₀ N₂ : Type v} [inst : AddCommGroup N₀] [inst_1 : Module R N₀] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup N₂]
        [inst_3 : Module R N₂] (g : N₀ →ₗ[R] N) (h : N →ₗ[R] N₂),
        Function.Exact ⇑g ⇑h →
          Function.Exact ⇑((LocalizedModule.map S) g) ⇑((LocalizedModule.map S) h)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_4.source:
/-- **Definition 4.4 (localization).**  Mathlib's `Localization S` and
`LocalizedModule S N` are the rings and modules of fractions with
`a/s = a'/s' ↔ t(s'a − sa') = 0` and `y/s = y'/s' ↔ t(s'y − sy') = 0` for some
`t ∈ S`, and localization is exact. -/
theorem definition_4_4 (S : Submonoid R) {N : Type v} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] :
    (∀ (a a' : R) (s s' : S),
        Localization.mk a s = Localization.mk a' s' ↔
          ∃ t : S, (t : R) * ((s' : R) * a - (s : R) * a') = 0) ∧
      (∀ (y y' : N) (s s' : S),
        LocalizedModule.mk y s = LocalizedModule.mk y' s' ↔
          ∃ t : S, t • (s' • y - s • y') = 0) ∧
      ∀ {N₀ N₂ : Type v} [AddCommGroup N₀] [Module R N₀] [AddCommGroup N₂] [Module R N₂]
        (g : N₀ →ₗ[R] N) (h : N →ₗ[R] N₂), Function.Exact g h →
          Function.Exact (LocalizedModule.map S g) (LocalizedModule.map S h) := by
  refine ⟨fun a a' s s' => ?_, fun y y' s s' => ?_, fun g h ex => ?_⟩
  · rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  · rw [LocalizedModule.mk_eq]
    simp only [smul_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  · exact LocalizedModule.map_exact S g h ex

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_5.{u_1, u_2} {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_2}
  [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : PrimeSpectrum R) : p ∈ Module.support R M ↔ ∃ z, z ≠ 0
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_5.source:
/-- **Definition 4.5 (support).**  `Supp_R(M) = {𝔭 | M_𝔭 ≠ 0}`. -/
theorem definition_4_5 {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    p ∈ Module.support R M ↔
      ∃ z : LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M, z ≠ 0 := by

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_6.doc:
**Definition 4.6 (length).**  `Module.length` is the number of steps of a
composition series `0 = N₀ ⊊ ⋯ ⊊ N_ℓ = N` (successive steps are coverings,
i.e. have simple quotients, `covBy_iff_quot_is_simple`), independent of the
series, and length is additive on short exact sequences.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_6.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_6.{v, u_2} {T : Type u_2} {M : Type v} [Ring T]
  [AddCommGroup M] [Module T M] :
  (∀ (s : CompositionSeries (Submodule T M)),
      RelSeries.head s = ⊥ → RelSeries.last s = ⊤ → ↑s.length = Module.length T M) ∧
    ∀ {N P : Type v} [inst : AddCommGroup N] [inst_1 : Module T N] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup P]
      [inst_3 : Module T P] (f : N →ₗ[T] M) (g : M →ₗ[T] P),
      Function.Injective ⇑f →
        Function.Surjective ⇑g →
          Function.Exact ⇑f ⇑g → Module.length T M = Module.length T N + Module.length T P
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.definition_4_6.source:
/-- **Definition 4.6 (length).**  `Module.length` is the number of steps of a
composition series `0 = N₀ ⊊ ⋯ ⊊ N_ℓ = N` (successive steps are coverings,
i.e. have simple quotients, `covBy_iff_quot_is_simple`), independent of the
series, and length is additive on short exact sequences. -/
theorem definition_4_6 {T : Type*} {M : Type v} [Ring T] [AddCommGroup M] [Module T M] :
    (∀ s : CompositionSeries (Submodule T M), s.head = ⊥ → s.last = ⊤ →
        (s.length : ℕ∞) = Module.length T M) ∧
      ∀ {N P : Type v} [AddCommGroup N] [Module T N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P]
        (f : N →ₗ[T] M) (g : M →ₗ[T] P), Function.Injective f → Function.Surjective g →
          Function.Exact f g → Module.length T M = Module.length T N + Module.length T P :=
  ⟨fun s h₁ h₂ => Module.length_compositionSeries s h₁ h₂,
    fun f g hf hg H => Module.length_eq_add_of_exact f g hf hg H⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.eq_nonnegative.doc:
**Equation (nonnegative-pbw).**  `E x₁ = x₁(E+1)`, `x₁E = (E−1)x₁`,
`Ep = p(E−1)`, `pE = (E+1)p`, from `p x₁ = x₁ p + 1`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.eq_nonnegative.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.eq_nonnegative_pbw.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] (x p : A)
  (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1) :
  eulerElement x p * x = x * (eulerElement x p + 1) ∧
    x * eulerElement x p = (eulerElement x p - 1) * x ∧
      eulerElement x p * p = p * (eulerElement x p - 1) ∧
        p * eulerElement x p = (eulerElement x p + 1) * p
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.eq_nonnegative.source:
/-- **Equation (nonnegative-pbw).**  `E x₁ = x₁(E+1)`, `x₁E = (E−1)x₁`,
`Ep = p(E−1)`, `pE = (E+1)p`, from `p x₁ = x₁ p + 1`. -/
theorem eq_nonnegative_pbw (x p : A) (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1) :
    eulerElement x p * x = x * (eulerElement x p + 1) ∧
      x * eulerElement x p = (eulerElement x p - 1) * x ∧
      eulerElement x p * p = p * (eulerElement x p - 1) ∧
      p * eulerElement x p = (eulerElement x p + 1) * p := by
  simp only [eulerElement]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mul_assoc, hweyl]
  · rw [sub_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc x p x, hweyl]
    noncomm_ring
  · rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc p x p, hweyl]
    noncomm_ring
  · rw [← mul_assoc, hweyl]
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.eq_nonnegative.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] (x p : A),
  p * x = x * p + 1 →
    x * p * x = x * (x * p + 1) ∧
      x * (x * p) = (x * p - 1) * x ∧ x * p * p = p * (x * p - 1) ∧ p * (x * p) = (x * p + 1) * p

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.eulerElement.signature: Stafford38.Paper.Section4.eulerElement.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] (x p : A) : A

abbrev eulerElement (x p : A) : A := x * p

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_1.doc:
**Lemma 4.1.** For `x₁, p = ∂₁ ∈ A_n(k)` and `E = x₁p`, for every `m ≥ 1`,
`x₁^m p^m = ∏_{i=0}^{m-1}(E−i)` and `p^m x₁^m = ∏_{i=1}^{m}(E+i)`, the factors in
each product commuting with one another.  The products are taken in the listed
order of `i` (`A_n(k)` is not commutative); by the last two clauses the order
does not matter.  Paper `n` is Lean `n + 1`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_1.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_1.{u_1} (k : Type u_1) [Field k] (n m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
  Section2.x₁ k n ^ m * p k n ^ m =
      (List.map (fun i => eulerElement (Section2.x₁ k n) (p k n) - ↑i) (List.range m)).prod ∧
    p k n ^ m * Section2.x₁ k n ^ m =
        (List.map (fun i => eulerElement (Section2.x₁ k n) (p k n) + ↑i) (List.range' 1 m)).prod ∧
      (∀ (i j : ℕ),
          Commute (eulerElement (Section2.x₁ k n) (p k n) - ↑i)
            (eulerElement (Section2.x₁ k n) (p k n) - ↑j)) ∧
        ∀ (i j : ℕ),
          Commute (eulerElement (Section2.x₁ k n) (p k n) + ↑i)
            (eulerElement (Section2.x₁ k n) (p k n) + ↑j)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_1.source:
/-- **Lemma 4.1.** For `x₁, p = ∂₁ ∈ A_n(k)` and `E = x₁p`, for every `m ≥ 1`,
`x₁^m p^m = ∏_{i=0}^{m-1}(E−i)` and `p^m x₁^m = ∏_{i=1}^{m}(E+i)`, the factors in
each product commuting with one another.  The products are taken in the listed
order of `i` (`A_n(k)` is not commutative); by the last two clauses the order
does not matter.  Paper `n` is Lean `n + 1`. -/
theorem lemma_4_1 (k : Type*) [Field k] (n m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    x₁ k n ^ m * p k n ^ m =
        ((List.range m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement (x₁ k n) (p k n) - i).prod ∧
      p k n ^ m * x₁ k n ^ m =
        ((List.range' 1 m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement (x₁ k n) (p k n) + i).prod ∧
      (∀ i j : ℕ, Commute (eulerElement (x₁ k n) (p k n) - i)
        (eulerElement (x₁ k n) (p k n) - j)) ∧
      ∀ i j : ℕ, Commute (eulerElement (x₁ k n) (p k n) + i)
        (eulerElement (x₁ k n) (p k n) + j) :=
  lemma_4_1_of_weylPair _ _ (convention_2_2_relations k n).1 m hm

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_10.doc:
**Lemma 4.10.** For every minimal prime `𝔮` of `Supp_T U`,
`ℓ_{T_𝔮}(U_𝔮) > ℓ_{T_𝔮}(V_𝔮)`, for `d̃` in the form (3.1) with `N ≥ 1`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_10.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_10.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ}
  {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hN : 0 < N)
  (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) (q : PrimeSpectrum (Tangential k n))
  (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d))
  (hqmin :
    ∀ p ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d),
      p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
  Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (cokernelU k n N d)) >
    Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl ↥(kernelV k n N d))
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_10.source:
/-- **Lemma 4.10.** For every minimal prime `𝔮` of `Supp_T U`,
`ℓ_{T_𝔮}(U_𝔮) > ℓ_{T_𝔮}(V_𝔮)`, for `d̃` in the form (3.1) with `N ≥ 1`. -/
theorem lemma_4_10 (hN : 0 < N) (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Tangential k n))
    (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d))
    (hqmin : ∀ p ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d),
      p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (cokernelU k n N d)) >
      Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (kernelV k n N d)) := by
  -- Lemma 4.8: `V_𝔮` has finite length
  have hd := isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm k hform
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hfin⟩ := lemma_4_8 hform
  have h := step_4_10_localized (R := Tangential k n) (symbolCoordinate k n) q
    (by rw [setup_coordinateMap_eq]; exact hqmem)
    (by rw [setup_coordinateMap_eq]; exact (hfin q hqmem hqmin).2)
    (step_4_10_localized_avoid hN hd q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
  rwa [setup_coordinateMap_eq] at h

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_1_of_w.doc:
Lemma 4.1 for any ring with elements `x, p` satisfying `p x = x p + 1`:
for every `m ≥ 1`, `x^m p^m = ∏_{i=0}^{m-1}(E−i)` and `p^m x^m = ∏_{i=1}^{m}(E+i)`
with `E = x p`, the factors in each product commuting with one another.  The
products are taken in the listed order of `i`; by the last two clauses the order
does not matter.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_1_of_w.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_1_of_weylPair.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] (x p : A)
  (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
  x ^ m * p ^ m = (List.map (fun i => eulerElement x p - ↑i) (List.range m)).prod ∧
    p ^ m * x ^ m = (List.map (fun i => eulerElement x p + ↑i) (List.range' 1 m)).prod ∧
      (∀ (i j : ℕ), Commute (eulerElement x p - ↑i) (eulerElement x p - ↑j)) ∧
        ∀ (i j : ℕ), Commute (eulerElement x p + ↑i) (eulerElement x p + ↑j)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_1_of_w.source:
/-- Lemma 4.1 for any ring with elements `x, p` satisfying `p x = x p + 1`:
for every `m ≥ 1`, `x^m p^m = ∏_{i=0}^{m-1}(E−i)` and `p^m x^m = ∏_{i=1}^{m}(E+i)`
with `E = x p`, the factors in each product commuting with one another.  The
products are taken in the listed order of `i`; by the last two clauses the order
does not matter. -/
theorem lemma_4_1_of_weylPair (x p : A) (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    x ^ m * p ^ m = ((List.range m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p - i).prod ∧
      p ^ m * x ^ m = ((List.range' 1 m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p + i).prod ∧
      (∀ i j : ℕ, Commute (eulerElement x p - i) (eulerElement x p - j)) ∧
      ∀ i j : ℕ, Commute (eulerElement x p + i) (eulerElement x p + j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, step_4_1_factors_commute x p⟩
  · -- induction from the trivial case `m = 1`
    induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp [eulerElement]
    | succ m _ ih => exact step_4_1_falling_succ x p hweyl m ih
  · induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp [eulerElement, hweyl]
    | succ m _ ih => exact step_4_1_rising_succ x p hweyl m ih
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_1_of_w.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] (x p : A),
  p * x = x * p + 1 →
    ∀ (m : ℕ),
      1 ≤ m →
        x ^ m * p ^ m = (List.map (fun i => x * p - ↑i) (List.range m)).prod ∧
          p ^ m * x ^ m = (List.map (fun i => x * p + ↑i) (List.range' 1 m)).prod ∧
            (∀ (i j : ℕ), Commute (x * p - ↑i) (x * p - ↑j)) ∧
              ∀ (i j : ℕ), Commute (x * p + ↑i) (x * p + ↑j)

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_2.doc:
**Lemma 4.2.** For `d̃` in the form (3.1) and `𝓘 = d̃A_n + x₁^N d̃A_n`
(Equation (3.2)), there is `u₀ ∈ A_{≥0}` with `1 + u₀ x₁ ∈ 𝓘`.  The proof uses
(3.1) only through its consequence `IsPBWMonicAt`
(`Section3.isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm`), and cites Lemma 4.1 for `m = N`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_2.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [Algebra ℚ k] {n N : ℕ}
  {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
  ∃ u₀ ∈ presentedNonnegativePart k n,
    1 + u₀ * WeylIteratedEquivalence.presentedCoordinate k n ∈ idealI k N d
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_2.source:
/-- **Lemma 4.2.** For `d̃` in the form (3.1) and `𝓘 = d̃A_n + x₁^N d̃A_n`
(Equation (3.2)), there is `u₀ ∈ A_{≥0}` with `1 + u₀ x₁ ∈ 𝓘`.  The proof uses
(3.1) only through its consequence `IsPBWMonicAt`
(`Section3.isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm`), and cites Lemma 4.1 for `m = N`. -/
theorem lemma_4_2 {N : ℕ} {d : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hform : Stafford38.Paper.Section3.IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
    ∃ u₀ ∈ presentedNonnegativePart k n,
      1 + u₀ * presentedCoordinate k n ∈ Stafford38.Paper.Section3.idealI k N d := by
  let := presentedRatAlgebra k n
  have hd := Stafford38.Paper.Section3.isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm k hform
  obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hright, hleft⟩ := step_4_2_presented_remainder hd
  exact lemma_4_2_of_positive (transverse k n) (presentedCoordinate k n)
    (presentedMomentum k n) d (d - presentedMomentum k n ^ N) N
    (Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2_relations k n).1
    (fun hN => ⟨(lemma_4_1 k n N hN).1, (lemma_4_1 k n N hN).2.1⟩)
    (transverse_commutes_coordinate k n) (rat_mem_transverse k n) (by abel) U V hU hV hright hleft

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_2_of_p.doc:
Lemma 4.2 for a Weyl pair, assembled from the three paragraphs, given the
identities of Lemma 4.1 for `m = N`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_2_of_p.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_2_of_positive.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] [Algebra ℚ A]
  (C : Subring A) (x p d sigma : A) (N : ℕ) (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1)
  (h41 :
    1 ≤ N →
      x ^ N * p ^ N = (List.map (fun i => eulerElement x p - ↑i) (List.range N)).prod ∧
        p ^ N * x ^ N = (List.map (fun i => eulerElement x p + ↑i) (List.range' 1 N)).prod)
  (hcomm : ∀ (c : ↥C), x * ↑c = ↑c * x) (hscalar : ∀ (q : ℚ), (algebraMap ℚ A) q ∈ C)
  (hd : d = p ^ N + sigma) (U V : A) (hU : U ∈ nonnegativePart C x p)
  (hV : V ∈ nonnegativePart C x p) (hright : sigma * x ^ N = U * x)
  (hleft : x ^ N * sigma = V * x) :
  ∃ u₀ ∈ nonnegativePart C x p, 1 + u₀ * x ∈ WeylEulerResidue.canonicalRightIdeal x d N
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_2_of_p.source:
/-- Lemma 4.2 for a Weyl pair, assembled from the three paragraphs, given the
identities of Lemma 4.1 for `m = N`. -/
theorem lemma_4_2_of_positive (C : Subring A) (x p d sigma : A) (N : ℕ)
    (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1)
    (h41 : 1 ≤ N →
      x ^ N * p ^ N = ((List.range N).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p - i).prod ∧
        p ^ N * x ^ N = ((List.range' 1 N).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p + i).prod)
    (hcomm : ∀ c : C, x * (c : A) = (c : A) * x)
    (hscalar : ∀ q : ℚ, algebraMap ℚ A q ∈ C)
    (hd : d = p ^ N + sigma)
    (U V : A) (hU : U ∈ nonnegativePart C x p) (hV : V ∈ nonnegativePart C x p)
    (hright : sigma * x ^ N = U * x) (hleft : x ^ N * sigma = V * x) :
    ∃ u₀ ∈ nonnegativePart C x p, 1 + u₀ * x ∈ canonicalRightIdeal x d N := by
  obtain ⟨u, v, hbez⟩ := step_4_2_bezout x p N h41
  obtain ⟨-, hmem⟩ := step_4_2_residue x p d sigma N u v hd hbez
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hw⟩ :=
    step_4_2_positive C x p sigma N hweyl hcomm hscalar U V hU hV hright hleft u v
  exact ⟨u₀, hu₀, hw ▸ hmem⟩
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_2_of_p.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] [inst_1 : Algebra ℚ A] (C : Subring A) (x p d sigma : A) (N : ℕ),
  p * x = x * p + 1 →
    (1 ≤ N →
        x ^ N * p ^ N = (List.map (fun i => x * p - ↑i) (List.range N)).prod ∧
          p ^ N * x ^ N = (List.map (fun i => x * p + ↑i) (List.range' 1 N)).prod) →
      (∀ (c : ↥C), x * ↑c = ↑c * x) →
        (∀ (q : ℚ), (algebraMap ℚ A) q ∈ C) →
          d = p ^ N + sigma →
            ∀ (U V : A),
              U ∈ Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {x, x * p}) →
                V ∈ Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {x, x * p}) →
                  sigma * x ^ N = U * x →
                    x ^ N * sigma = V * x →
                      ∃ u₀ ∈ Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {x, x * p}),
                        1 + u₀ * x ∈ Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ {d, x ^ N * d}

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_7.doc: **Lemma 4.7.** `𝔭 ∈ Supp_R(N)` iff there is `y ∈ N` with `Ann_R(y) ⊆ 𝔭`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_7.source:
/-- **Lemma 4.7.** `𝔭 ∈ Supp_R(N)` iff there is `y ∈ N` with `Ann_R(y) ⊆ 𝔭`. -/
theorem lemma_4_7 (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    p ∈ Module.support R N ↔ ∃ y : N, (R ∙ y).annihilator ≤ p.asIdeal := by
  rw [definition_4_5]
  constructor
  · -- (⇒) a nonzero `y/s` gives `y/1 ≠ 0`
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    induction z using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
    | h y s =>
        refine ⟨y, (step_4_7_mk_one_ne_zero_iff p y).1 ?_⟩
        rwa [ne_eq, ← step_4_7_mk_eq_zero_iff p y s]
  · -- (⇐) `y/1 ≠ 0`
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ⟨_, (step_4_7_mk_one_ne_zero_iff p y).2 hy⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_8.doc:
**Lemma 4.8.** `U` and `V` are finite over `T`, `Supp_T V ⊆ Supp_T U`, and at a
minimal prime `𝔮` of `Supp_T U`, `U_𝔮` and `V_𝔮` have finite length over `T_𝔮`.
Here `d̃` is in the form (3.1), used through `IsPBWMonicAt`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_8.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_8.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n N : ℕ}
  {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
  Module.Finite (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d) ∧
    Module.Finite (Tangential k n) ↥(kernelV k n N d) ∧
      Module.support (Tangential k n) ↥(kernelV k n N d) ⊆
          Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d) ∧
        ∀ q ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d),
          (∀ p ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d),
              p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) →
            IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
                (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (cokernelU k n N d)) ∧
              IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
                (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl ↥(kernelV k n N d))
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_8.source:
/-- **Lemma 4.8.** `U` and `V` are finite over `T`, `Supp_T V ⊆ Supp_T U`, and at a
minimal prime `𝔮` of `Supp_T U`, `U_𝔮` and `V_𝔮` have finite length over `T_𝔮`.
Here `d̃` is in the form (3.1), used through `IsPBWMonicAt`. -/
theorem lemma_4_8 (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
    Module.Finite (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d) ∧
      Module.Finite (Tangential k n) (kernelV k n N d) ∧
      Module.support (Tangential k n) (kernelV k n N d) ⊆
        Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d),
        (∀ p ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d),
          p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) →
        IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
            (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (cokernelU k n N d)) ∧
          IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
            (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (kernelV k n N d)) := by
  have hd := isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm k hform
  obtain ⟨hU, hV⟩ := step_4_8_finite hd
  have hsupp : Module.support (Tangential k n) (kernelV k n N d) ⊆
      Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d) := by
    have h := step_4_8_support_inclusion (R := Tangential k n)
      (LinearMap.lsmul (Symbol k n) (GrQ k n N d) (symbolCoordinate k n))
    rwa [setup_coordinateMap_eq] at h
  exact ⟨hU, hV, hsupp, fun q hqmem hq => step_4_8_finite_length hsupp q hqmem hq⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_9.doc:
**Lemma 4.9.** For every minimal prime `𝔮` of `Supp_T U`,
`ℓ_{T_𝔮}(U_𝔮) ≤ ℓ_{T_𝔮}(V_𝔮)`, for `d̃` in the form (3.1).
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_9.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_9.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [Algebra ℚ k] {n N : ℕ}
  {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d)
  (q : PrimeSpectrum (Tangential k n))
  (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d))
  (hqmin :
    ∀ p ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d),
      p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
  Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (cokernelU k n N d)) ≤
    Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl ↥(kernelV k n N d))
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.lemma_4_9.source:
/-- **Lemma 4.9.** For every minimal prime `𝔮` of `Supp_T U`,
`ℓ_{T_𝔮}(U_𝔮) ≤ ℓ_{T_𝔮}(V_𝔮)`, for `d̃` in the form (3.1). -/
theorem lemma_4_9 (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Tangential k n))
    (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d))
    (hqmin : ∀ p ∈ Module.support (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d),
      p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (cokernelU k n N d)) ≤
      Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (kernelV k n N d)) := by
  have hd := isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm k hform
  let S := q.asIdeal.primeCompl
  let A : ℕ → Type _ := fun r => LocalizedModule S ((complex k n N d hd).SourceTotal r)
  let B : ℕ → Type _ := fun r => LocalizedModule S ((complex k n N d hd).TargetTotal r)
  let : ∀ r, AddCommGroup (A r) := fun r => by dsimp only [A]; infer_instance
  let : ∀ r, Module (Localization S) (A r) := fun r => by dsimp only [A]; infer_instance
  let : ∀ r, AddCommGroup (B r) := fun r => by dsimp only [B]; infer_instance
  let : ∀ r, Module (Localization S) (B r) := fun r => by dsimp only [B]; infer_instance
  -- the pages and their localization; exactness keeps the successor identities
  obtain ⟨hsucc, htsucc, ⟨eV⟩, ⟨eU⟩⟩ := step_4_9_pages hd
  let dd : ∀ r, A r →ₗ[Localization S] B r := fun r =>
    localizedMap S (tangentialDrop k n N d hd r)
  let es : ∀ r, A (r + 1) ≃ₗ[Localization S] LinearMap.ker (dd r) := fun r =>
    (localizedEquiv S (hsucc r).some).trans (localizedKernelEquiv S _)
  let et : ∀ r, B (r + 1) ≃ₗ[Localization S] B r ⧸ LinearMap.range (dd r) := fun r =>
    (localizedEquiv S (htsucc r).some).trans (localizedCokernelEquiv S _)
  let eV' : A 1 ≃ₗ[Localization S] LocalizedModule S (kernelV k n N d) := localizedEquiv S eV
  let eU' : B 1 ≃ₗ[Localization S] LocalizedModule S (cokernelU k n N d) :=
    localizedEquiv S eU
  -- Lemma 4.8: `(A_1)_𝔮 = V_𝔮` and `(B_1)_𝔮 = U_𝔮` have finite length
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hfin⟩ := lemma_4_8 hform
  obtain ⟨hU, hV⟩ := hfin q hqmem hqmin
  have hfl := step_4_9_pages_finite_length dd es et (eV'.symm.isFiniteLength hV)
    (eU'.symm.isFiniteLength hU)
  -- exhaustion: `(B_R)_𝔮 = 0`
  let : IsNoetherian (Localization S) (B 1) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp (hfl 1 le_rfl).2).1
  obtain ⟨R', hR'⟩ := step_4_9_exhaustion hform S
  -- equation (additivity) and the telescoping sum
  have hlen := step_4_9_telescope
    (fun r => if 1 ≤ r then Module.length (Localization S) (A r) else 0)
    (fun r => if 1 ≤ r then Module.length (Localization S) (B r) else 0)
    (fun r => by
      split_ifs with h
      · exact Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr (hfl r h).1
      · exact ENat.zero_ne_top)
    (fun r => by
      split_ifs with h
      · exact Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr (hfl r h).2
      · exact ENat.zero_ne_top)
    (fun r hr => by
      simp only [hr, ite_true, show 1 ≤ r + 1 by omega]
      exact step_4_9_additivity (dd r) (es r) (et r))
    (R' + 1) (by omega)
  simp only [le_refl, ite_true, show 1 ≤ R' + 1 by omega] at hlen
  have hBR : Module.length (Localization S) (B (R' + 1)) = 0 :=
    Module.length_eq_zero_iff.mpr hR'
  -- `ℓ(U_𝔮) + ℓ((A_R)_𝔮) = ℓ(V_𝔮)`, and `ℓ((A_R)_𝔮) ≥ 0`
  calc Module.length (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S (cokernelU k n N d))
        = Module.length (Localization S) (B 1) := eU'.length_eq.symm
    _ ≤ Module.length (Localization S) (B 1) + Module.length (Localization S) (A (R' + 1)) :=
        le_self_add
    _ = Module.length (Localization S) (A 1) := by rw [hlen, hBR, add_zero]
    _ = Module.length (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S (kernelV k n N d)) := eV'.length_eq

    (hform : Stafford38.Paper.Section3.IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
    Function.Surjective
      (rightMul (Stafford38.Paper.Section3.idealI k N d) (presentedCoordinate k n)) := by
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hres⟩ := lemma_4_2 hform
  exact proposition_4_3_of (transverseCoordinateAlgebra k n)
    (presentedCoordinate k n) (presentedMomentum k n) u₀

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.proposition_4_.doc:
Proposition 4.3 for a ring with a right ideal, assembled from the
paragraphs: equation (normal-surj) with `qA_{≥0} = Q` reads `Q = Qx₁`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.proposition_4_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.proposition_4_3_of.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A]
  {I : EulerSurjectivity.RightIdeal A} {R : Subring A} (C : Subring A) (x p u₀ : A) (hx : x ∈ R)
  (hE : x * p ∈ R) (hC : C ≤ R) (hnormal : ∀ r ∈ R, ∃ r' ∈ R, x * r = r' * x) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ R)
  (hres : 1 + u₀ * x ∈ I) (hgenerate : Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {p}) = ⊤) :
  Function.Surjective (EulerSurjectivity.rightMul I x)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.proposition_4_.source:
/-- Proposition 4.3 for a ring with a right ideal, assembled from the
paragraphs: equation (normal-surj) with `qA_{≥0} = Q` reads `Q = Qx₁`. -/
theorem proposition_4_3_of (C : Subring A) (x p u₀ : A)
    (hx : x ∈ R) (hE : x * p ∈ R) (hC : C ≤ R)
    (hnormal : ∀ r ∈ R, ∃ r' ∈ R, x * r = r' * x)
    (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ R) (hres : 1 + u₀ * x ∈ I)
    (hgenerate : Subring.closure ((C : Set A) ∪ {p}) = ⊤) :
    Function.Surjective (rightMul I x) := by
  have hsurj := step_4_3_normal_surj x u₀ hx hu₀ hres hnormal
  have huniv := step_4_3_classSet_eq_univ C p
    (step_4_3_stable_coefficients C hC) (step_4_3_stable_momentum x p hE hsurj) hgenerate
  intro z
  have hz : z ∈ rightMul I x '' classSet I R := by
    rw [← hsurj, huniv]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨w, -, hw⟩ := hz
  exact ⟨w, hw⟩

∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] {I : Submodule Aᵐᵒᵖ A} {R : Subring A} (C : Subring A)
  (x p u₀ : A),

    x * p ∈ R →
      C ≤ R →
        (∀ r ∈ R, ∃ r' ∈ R, x * r = r' * x) →
          u₀ ∈ R →
            1 + u₀ * x ∈ I →
              Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {p}) = ⊤ → Function.Surjective fun q => MulOpposite.op x • q

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_core.doc:
The length comparison over a base ring, assembled from the paragraphs above:
`ℓ(U) = ℓ(V) + ℓ(Ẽ/x₁Ẽ) > ℓ(V)`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_core.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_core.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {R : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2}
  {E : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C] [AddCommGroup E] [Module C E] [Module R E]
  [IsScalarTower R C E] [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (x : C)
  (havoid : ∀ p ∈ (Module.annihilator C E).minimalPrimes, x ∉ p) (hU : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop x E))
  (hV : IsFiniteLength R ↥(↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x)).ker) :
  Module.length R (E ⧸ (↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x)).range) >
    Module.length R ↥(↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x)).ker
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_core.source:
/-- The length comparison over a base ring, assembled from the paragraphs above:
`ℓ(U) = ℓ(V) + ℓ(Ẽ/x₁Ẽ) > ℓ(V)`. -/
theorem step_4_10_core [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (x : C)
    (havoid : ∀ p ∈ (Module.annihilator C E).minimalPrimes, x ∉ p)
    (hU : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop x E))
    (hV : IsFiniteLength R (LinearMap.ker ((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R))) :
    Module.length R (E ⧸ LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R)) >
      Module.length R (LinearMap.ker ((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R)) := by
  let f : Module.End R E := (LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R
  obtain ⟨m, hstable, hK⟩ := step_4_10_stable_kernel x hV
  obtain ⟨hcomap, hinter⟩ := step_4_10_two_facts f m hstable
  have hsplit := step_4_10_length_split f _ hK hcomap hinter
  have hres := step_4_10_residual_nonzero (R := R) x havoid hU m
  have hpos : 0 < Module.length R (E ⧸ (LinearMap.ker (f ^ m) ⊔ LinearMap.range f)) :=
    Module.length_pos
  change Module.length R (E ⧸ LinearMap.range f) > Module.length R (LinearMap.ker f)
  rw [hsplit]
  have hVtop : Module.length R (LinearMap.ker f) ≠ ⊤ := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr hV
  simpa [add_comm] using ENat.lt_add_left hVtop hpos

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_gabb.doc:

`ξ₁`-derivatives of `P ∈ 𝔭` and the `N`-th is `N! ≠ 0`, so `x₁ ∉ 𝔭`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_gabb.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_gabber.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ}

  P ∈ (Module.annihilator (Symbol k n) (GrQ k n N d)).minimalPrimes → symbolCoordinate k n ∉ P
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_gabb.source:
/-- **Gabber paragraph.**  `J = √Ann M` is involutive (Gabber), so are its minimal

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_kern.doc:
**`ℓ(K_∞/x₁K_∞) = ℓ(V)`.**  For an endomorphism `φ` of a finite-length module,
additivity along `0 → ker φ → L → φL → 0` and `0 → φL → L → L/φL → 0` gives
`ℓ(ker φ) = ℓ(L/φL)`; for `φ = f|_{K_∞}`, `ker φ = ker f` as `ker f ⊆ K_∞`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_kern.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_kernel_length.{u_1, u_3} {R : Type u_1} {E : Type u_3}
  [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] (f : Module.End R E) (K : Submodule R E)
  (hK : IsFiniteLength R ↥K) (hcomap : Submodule.comap f K = K) :
  Module.length R (↥K ⧸ (LinearMap.restrict f ⋯).range) = Module.length R ↥(LinearMap.ker f)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_kern.source:
/-- **`ℓ(K_∞/x₁K_∞) = ℓ(V)`.**  For an endomorphism `φ` of a finite-length module,
additivity along `0 → ker φ → L → φL → 0` and `0 → φL → L → L/φL → 0` gives
`ℓ(ker φ) = ℓ(L/φL)`; for `φ = f|_{K_∞}`, `ker φ = ker f` as `ker f ⊆ K_∞`. -/
theorem step_4_10_kernel_length (f : Module.End R E) (K : Submodule R E)
    (hK : IsFiniteLength R K) (hcomap : K.comap f = K) :
    Module.length R (K ⧸ LinearMap.range (f.restrict (p := K) (q := K)
        (fun z hz => show z ∈ K.comap f from hcomap.symm ▸ hz))) =
      Module.length R (LinearMap.ker f) := by
  let fK : Module.End R K := f.restrict (fun z hz => show z ∈ K.comap f from hcomap.symm ▸ hz)
  have hparts := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hK
  let : IsNoetherian R K := hparts.1
  let : IsArtinian R K := hparts.2
  have hkerle : LinearMap.ker f ≤ K := by
    intro z hz
    rw [← hcomap]
    change f z ∈ K
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hz]
    exact K.zero_mem
  have hker : Module.length R (LinearMap.ker fK) = Module.length R (LinearMap.ker f) := by
    have hk : LinearMap.ker fK = (LinearMap.ker f).comap K.subtype := by
      simp [fK, LinearMap.ker_restrict]
    rw [hk]
    exact (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hkerle).length_eq
  have hsource := (definition_4_6 (T := R) (M := K)).2 (LinearMap.ker fK).subtype
    fK.rangeRestrict (Submodule.subtype_injective _)
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp (LinearMap.range_rangeRestrict fK))
    (by rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, Submodule.range_subtype, LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict])
  have htarget := (definition_4_6 (T := R) (M := K)).2 (LinearMap.range fK).subtype
    (LinearMap.range fK).mkQ (Submodule.subtype_injective _) (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
    (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ _)
  rw [← hker]
  apply ENat.add_left_injective_of_ne_top (Module.length_ne_top (R := R) (M := LinearMap.range fK))
  change Module.length R (K ⧸ LinearMap.range fK) + Module.length R (LinearMap.range fK) =
    Module.length R (LinearMap.ker fK) + Module.length R (LinearMap.range fK)
  rw [add_comm (Module.length R (K ⧸ LinearMap.range fK)), ← htarget]
  exact hsource

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_leng.doc:
**The split `ℓ(U) = ℓ(V) + ℓ(Ẽ/x₁Ẽ)`.**  `E/fE → Ẽ/fẼ` is onto with kernel
`(K_∞ + fE)/fE ≅ K_∞/(K_∞ ∩ fE) = K_∞/fK_∞`; additivity and
`ℓ(K_∞/fK_∞) = ℓ(V)` give the split.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_leng.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_length_split.{u_1, u_3} {R : Type u_1} {E : Type u_3}
  [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] (f : Module.End R E) (K : Submodule R E)
  (hK : IsFiniteLength R ↥K) (hcomap : Submodule.comap f K = K)
  (hinter : K ⊓ LinearMap.range f = Submodule.map f K) :
  Module.length R (E ⧸ LinearMap.range f) =
    Module.length R ↥(LinearMap.ker f) + Module.length R (E ⧸ K ⊔ LinearMap.range f)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_leng.source:
/-- **The split `ℓ(U) = ℓ(V) + ℓ(Ẽ/x₁Ẽ)`.**  `E/fE → Ẽ/fẼ` is onto with kernel
`(K_∞ + fE)/fE ≅ K_∞/(K_∞ ∩ fE) = K_∞/fK_∞`; additivity and
`ℓ(K_∞/fK_∞) = ℓ(V)` give the split. -/
theorem step_4_10_length_split (f : Module.End R E) (K : Submodule R E)
    (hK : IsFiniteLength R K) (hcomap : K.comap f = K)
    (hinter : K ⊓ LinearMap.range f = K.map f) :
    Module.length R (E ⧸ LinearMap.range f) =
      Module.length R (LinearMap.ker f) + Module.length R (E ⧸ (K ⊔ LinearMap.range f)) := by
  have hstable : ∀ z ∈ K, f z ∈ K := fun z hz =>
    show z ∈ K.comap f from hcomap.symm ▸ hz
  let fK : Module.End R K := f.restrict hstable
  have hpre : (LinearMap.range f).comap K.subtype = LinearMap.range fK := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have hz' : (z : E) ∈ K.map f := hinter ▸ ⟨z.2, hz⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := hz'
      exact ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, Subtype.ext hwz⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨w.val, rfl⟩
  let i : (K ⧸ LinearMap.range fK) →ₗ[R] (E ⧸ LinearMap.range f) :=
    (LinearMap.range fK).mapQ (LinearMap.range f) K.subtype hpre.ge
  let j : (E ⧸ LinearMap.range f) →ₗ[R] (E ⧸ (K ⊔ LinearMap.range f)) :=
    (LinearMap.range f).mapQ (K ⊔ LinearMap.range f) LinearMap.id le_sup_right
  have hi : Function.Injective i := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
    dsimp [i]
    rw [Submodule.ker_mapQ, hpre, Submodule.mkQ_map_self]
  have hj : Function.Surjective j := by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    simp [j, Submodule.range_mapQ]
  have hexact : Function.Exact i j := by
    rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]
    simp [i, j, Submodule.range_mapQ, Submodule.ker_mapQ, Submodule.map_sup,
      Submodule.mkQ_map_self]
  have hsum := (definition_4_6 (T := R) (M := E ⧸ LinearMap.range f)).2 i j hi hj hexact
  rw [hsum, step_4_10_kernel_length f K hK hcomap]

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_loca.doc:
**Localizing at `S = T∖𝔮`.**  `M_𝔮 = S⁻¹M` over `T_𝔮` is the coefficient
localization `k[x,ξ]_𝔮 = S⁻¹k[x,ξ]` acting on `S⁻¹M`; there `U_𝔮 = M_𝔮/x₁M_𝔮 ≠ 0`
(`𝔮 ∈ Supp_T U`) and `V_𝔮 = ker(x₁ on M_𝔮)`, so `step_4_10_core` applies.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_loca.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_localized.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {R : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2}
  {E : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C] [AddCommGroup E] [Module C E] [Module R E]
  [IsScalarTower R C E] [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (x : C) (q : PrimeSpectrum R)
  (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support R (E ⧸ (↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x)).range))
  (hkerfinite :
    IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl ↥(↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x)).ker))
  (havoid :
    ∀
      Q ∈
        (Module.annihilator (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C q.asIdeal.primeCompl))
            (LocalizedModule (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C q.asIdeal.primeCompl) E)).minimalPrimes,
      (algebraMap C (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C q.asIdeal.primeCompl))) x ∉ Q) :
  Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (E ⧸ (↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x)).range)) >
    Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl ↥(↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x)).ker)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_loca.source:
/-- **Localizing at `S = T∖𝔮`.**  `M_𝔮 = S⁻¹M` over `T_𝔮` is the coefficient
localization `k[x,ξ]_𝔮 = S⁻¹k[x,ξ]` acting on `S⁻¹M`; there `U_𝔮 = M_𝔮/x₁M_𝔮 ≠ 0`
(`𝔮 ∈ Supp_T U`) and `V_𝔮 = ker(x₁ on M_𝔮)`, so `step_4_10_core` applies. -/
theorem step_4_10_localized [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (x : C)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support R
      (E ⧸ LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R)))
    (hkerfinite : IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl
        (LinearMap.ker ((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R))))
    (havoid : ∀ Q ∈ (Module.annihilator
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C q.asIdeal.primeCompl))
        (LocalizedModule (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C q.asIdeal.primeCompl) E)).minimalPrimes,
      algebraMap C (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C q.asIdeal.primeCompl)) x ∉ Q) :
    Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl
          (E ⧸ LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R))) >
      Module.length (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl
          (LinearMap.ker ((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R))) := by
  let S : Submonoid R := q.asIdeal.primeCompl
  let SC : Submonoid C := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C S
  let fC : Module.End C E := LinearMap.lsmul C E x
  let fR : Module.End R E := fC.restrictScalars R
  -- compare the base localization `M_𝔮 = S⁻¹M` with the coefficient localization
  let : Module (Localization S) (LocalizedModule SC E) :=
    Module.compHom _ (algebraMap (Localization S) (Localization SC))
  let : IsScalarTower (Localization S) (Localization SC) (LocalizedModule SC E) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_compHom (Localization S) (Localization SC) (LocalizedModule SC E)
  let e : LocalizedModule S E ≃ₗ[Localization S] LocalizedModule SC E :=
    localizedModuleComparison S
  let gR : Module.End (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S E) := localizedMap S fR
  let y : Localization SC := algebraMap C (Localization SC) x
  let gC : Module.End (Localization SC) (LocalizedModule SC E) :=
    LinearMap.lsmul (Localization SC) (LocalizedModule SC E) y
  have heq (z : LocalizedModule S E) : e (gR z) = gC (e z) := by
    rw [show e (gR z) = LocalizedModule.map SC fC (e z) by
      exact localizedModuleComparison_natural S fC z]
    induction e z using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
    | _ m s => simp [gC, y, fC, LocalizedModule.smul'_mk]
  let ek : LinearMap.ker gR ≃ₗ[Localization S]
      LinearMap.ker (gC.restrictScalars (Localization S)) :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective
      (e.toLinearMap.domRestrict (LinearMap.ker gR) |>.codRestrict
        (LinearMap.ker (gC.restrictScalars (Localization S))) (fun z => by
          exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (by simpa using (heq z).symm)))
      (by
        constructor
        · intro a b hab
          exact Subtype.ext (e.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hab))
        · intro z
          refine ⟨⟨e.symm z, ?_⟩, Subtype.ext (e.apply_symm_apply z)⟩
          exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (e.injective (by
            rw [heq]
            simpa using z.property)))
  have herange : Submodule.map e.toLinearMap (LinearMap.range gR) =
      LinearMap.range (gC.restrictScalars (Localization S)) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e a, by simpa using (heq a).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨gR (e.symm a), ⟨e.symm a, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa using heq (e.symm a)
  let ec : (LocalizedModule S E ⧸ LinearMap.range gR) ≃ₗ[Localization S]
      (LocalizedModule SC E ⧸ LinearMap.range (gC.restrictScalars (Localization S))) :=
    Submodule.Quotient.equiv _ _ e herange
  -- `𝔮 ∈ Supp_T U`, so `U_𝔮 = M_𝔮/x₁M_𝔮 ≠ 0`
  have hnontrivBase : Nontrivial (LocalizedModule S (E ⧸ LinearMap.range fR)) := by
    exact Module.mem_support_iff.mp hqmem
  have hnontrivCokerR : Nontrivial (LocalizedModule S E ⧸ LinearMap.range gR) :=
    not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp (by
      intro hs
      have : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule S (E ⧸ LinearMap.range fR)) :=
        (localizedCokernelEquiv S fR).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr hs
      exact not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mpr hnontrivBase this)
  have hnontrivCokerC : Nontrivial
      (LocalizedModule SC E ⧸ LinearMap.range (gC.restrictScalars (Localization S))) :=
    not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp (by
      intro hs
      exact not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mpr hnontrivCokerR
        (ec.toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr hs))
  have hrange : LinearMap.range gC =
      y • (⊤ : Submodule (Localization SC) (LocalizedModule SC E)) := by
    ext z
    rw [LinearMap.mem_range, Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
    simp only [Submodule.mem_top, true_and]
    rfl
  have hnontrivQuot : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop y (LocalizedModule SC E)) := by
    change Nontrivial (LocalizedModule SC E ⧸
      y • (⊤ : Submodule (Localization SC) (LocalizedModule SC E)))
    rw [← hrange]
    exact hnontrivCokerC
  have hkbase : IsFiniteLength (Localization S) (LinearMap.ker gR) :=
    (localizedKernelEquiv S fR).isFiniteLength hkerfinite
  have hkfinite : IsFiniteLength (Localization S)
      (LinearMap.ker (gC.restrictScalars (Localization S))) :=
    ek.isFiniteLength hkbase
  -- the strict inequality over `T_𝔮`, from the paragraphs above
  have hpos := step_4_10_core (R := Localization S) (C := Localization SC)
    (E := LocalizedModule SC E) y havoid hnontrivQuot hkfinite
  have h1 : Module.length (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S (E ⧸ LinearMap.range fR)) =
      Module.length (Localization S)
        (LocalizedModule SC E ⧸ LinearMap.range (gC.restrictScalars (Localization S))) :=
    (localizedCokernelEquiv S fR).length_eq.trans ec.length_eq
  have hek : Module.length (Localization S) (LinearMap.ker gR) =
      Module.length (Localization S) (LinearMap.ker (gC.restrictScalars (Localization S))) := by
    exact ek.length_eq
  have h2 : Module.length (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S (LinearMap.ker fR)) =
      Module.length (Localization S) (LinearMap.ker (gC.restrictScalars (Localization S))) :=
    (localizedKernelEquiv S fR).length_eq.trans hek
  change Module.length (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S (LinearMap.ker fR)) <
    Module.length (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S (E ⧸ LinearMap.range fR))
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact hpos

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_resi.doc:
**Nakayama paragraph: `Ẽ/x₁Ẽ ≠ 0`.**  Pick `𝔓` in the support of `E/x₁E ≠ 0`
and `𝔭' ⊆ 𝔓` minimal in `Supp E`; `x₁ ∉ 𝔭'`, so `K_∞` vanishes at `𝔭'` and
`Ẽ_{𝔭'} = E_{𝔭'} ≠ 0`; hence `Ẽ_𝔓 ≠ 0`, and as `x₁ ∈ 𝔓`, Nakayama gives
`(Ẽ/x₁Ẽ)_𝔓 ≠ 0`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_residual_nonzero.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {R : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2}
  {E : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C] [AddCommGroup E] [Module C E] [Module R E]
  [IsScalarTower R C E] [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (x : C)
  (havoid : ∀ p ∈ (Module.annihilator C E).minimalPrimes, x ∉ p) (hU : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop x E))
  (m : ℕ) :
  Nontrivial (E ⧸ (↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x) ^ m).ker ⊔ (↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x)).range)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_resi.source:
/-- **Nakayama paragraph: `Ẽ/x₁Ẽ ≠ 0`.**  Pick `𝔓` in the support of `E/x₁E ≠ 0`
and `𝔭' ⊆ 𝔓` minimal in `Supp E`; `x₁ ∉ 𝔭'`, so `K_∞` vanishes at `𝔭'` and
`Ẽ_{𝔭'} = E_{𝔭'} ≠ 0`; hence `Ẽ_𝔓 ≠ 0`, and as `x₁ ∈ 𝔓`, Nakayama gives
`(Ẽ/x₁Ẽ)_𝔓 ≠ 0`. -/
theorem step_4_10_residual_nonzero [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (x : C)
    (havoid : ∀ p ∈ (Module.annihilator C E).minimalPrimes, x ∉ p)
    (hU : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop x E)) (m : ℕ) :
    Nontrivial (E ⧸ (LinearMap.ker (((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R) ^ m) ⊔
      LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R))) := by
  let fC : Module.End C E := LinearMap.lsmul C E x
  let fR : Module.End R E := fC.restrictScalars R
  -- `𝔓 ∈ Supp(E/x₁E)` and a minimal `𝔭' ⊆ 𝔓` of `Supp E`
  obtain ⟨P, hPquot⟩ := Module.nonempty_support_of_nontrivial (R := C) (M := QuotSMulTop x E)
  have hPE : P ∈ Module.support C E := by
    have h := hPquot
    rw [Module.support_quotSMulTop] at h
    exact h.1
  obtain ⟨p, hpmin, hpP⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := Module.annihilator C E)
    (J := P.asIdeal) (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hPE)
  let p' : PrimeSpectrum C := ⟨p, hpmin.1.1⟩
  have hp' : p' ∈ Module.support C E := Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mpr hpmin.1.2
  have hnonzeroC : Nontrivial (E ⧸ (LinearMap.ker (fC ^ m) ⊔ LinearMap.range fC)) :=
    StableTorsionResidualSupport.residual_nontrivial_of_support x m p' P hp' hpP
      (havoid p hpmin) hPquot
  have hpow : ∀ j, fR ^ j = (fC ^ j).restrictScalars R := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => ext z; simp
    | succ j ih =>
        rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ih]
        ext z
        simp [fR, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
  have hPR : LinearMap.ker (fR ^ m) ⊔ LinearMap.range fR =
      (LinearMap.ker (fC ^ m) ⊔ LinearMap.range fC).restrictScalars R := by
    rw [hpow m]
    simp only [LinearMap.ker_restrictScalars, Submodule.restrictScalars_sup]
    rfl
  apply Submodule.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
  intro htop
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mp hnonzeroC)
  apply (Submodule.restrictScalars_eq_top_iff R C E).mp
  change LinearMap.ker (fR ^ m) ⊔ LinearMap.range fR = ⊤ at htop
  rw [← hPR, htop]

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_stab.doc:
**`K_∞`.**  The chain `ker f ⊆ ker f² ⊆ ⋯` stabilizes (`E` is Noetherian), at
`K_∞ = ker f^m = ker f^{m+1}`; the layers `ker f^{i+1}/ker f^i` inject into `V`
via `v ↦ x₁^i v`, so `K_∞` has finite length with `V`.

  {E : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C] [AddCommGroup E] [Module C E] [Module R E]
  [IsScalarTower R C E] [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (x : C)
  (hV : IsFiniteLength R ↥(↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x)).ker) :
  ∃ m,
    (↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x) ^ m).ker = (↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x) ^ (m + 1)).ker ∧
      IsFiniteLength R ↥(↑R ((LinearMap.lsmul C E) x) ^ m).ker
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_stab.source:
/-- **`K_∞`.**  The chain `ker f ⊆ ker f² ⊆ ⋯` stabilizes (`E` is Noetherian), at
`K_∞ = ker f^m = ker f^{m+1}`; the layers `ker f^{i+1}/ker f^i` inject into `V`
via `v ↦ x₁^i v`, so `K_∞` has finite length with `V`. -/
theorem step_4_10_stable_kernel [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (x : C)
    (hV : IsFiniteLength R (LinearMap.ker ((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R))) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      LinearMap.ker (((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R) ^ m) =
          LinearMap.ker (((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R) ^ (m + 1)) ∧
        IsFiniteLength R (LinearMap.ker (((LinearMap.lsmul C E x).restrictScalars R) ^ m)) := by
  let fC : Module.End C E := LinearMap.lsmul C E x
  let fR : Module.End R E := fC.restrictScalars R
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := PrincipalKoszulPositivity.exists_stable_kernel_power_smul (E := E) x
  have hpow : ∀ j, fR ^ j = (fC ^ j).restrictScalars R := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => ext z; simp
    | succ j ih =>
        rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ih]
        ext z
        simp [fR, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
  refine ⟨m, ?_, PrincipalKoszulFiniteTorsion.isFiniteLength_kernel_power fR hV m⟩
  change LinearMap.ker (fR ^ m) = LinearMap.ker (fR ^ (m + 1))
  rw [hpow, hpow, LinearMap.ker_restrictScalars, LinearMap.ker_restrictScalars]
  exact congrArg (Submodule.restrictScalars R) hm

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_two_.doc:
**The two elementary facts.**  For `K_∞ = ker f^m = ker f^{m+1}`:
`f⁻¹K_∞ = K_∞` and `K_∞ ∩ fE = f(K_∞)`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_two_facts.{u_1, u_3} {R : Type u_1} {E : Type u_3} [CommRing R]
  [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] (f : Module.End R E) (m : ℕ)
  (hstable : LinearMap.ker (f ^ m) = LinearMap.ker (f ^ (m + 1))) :
  Submodule.comap f (LinearMap.ker (f ^ m)) = LinearMap.ker (f ^ m) ∧
    LinearMap.ker (f ^ m) ⊓ LinearMap.range f = Submodule.map f (LinearMap.ker (f ^ m))
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_10_two_.source:
/-- **The two elementary facts.**  For `K_∞ = ker f^m = ker f^{m+1}`:
`f⁻¹K_∞ = K_∞` and `K_∞ ∩ fE = f(K_∞)`. -/
theorem step_4_10_two_facts (f : Module.End R E) (m : ℕ)
    (hstable : LinearMap.ker (f ^ m) = LinearMap.ker (f ^ (m + 1))) :
    (LinearMap.ker (f ^ m)).comap f = LinearMap.ker (f ^ m) ∧
      LinearMap.ker (f ^ m) ⊓ LinearMap.range f = (LinearMap.ker (f ^ m)).map f := by
  have hcomap : (LinearMap.ker (f ^ m)).comap f = LinearMap.ker (f ^ m) := by
    ext z
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
    change (f ^ m) (f z) = 0 ↔ (f ^ m) z = 0
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, (Commute.self_pow f m).eq.symm, Module.End.mul_apply]
    simpa [Module.End.pow_apply, Function.iterate_succ_apply'] using
      congrArg (fun K : Submodule R E ↦ z ∈ K) hstable.symm
  refine ⟨hcomap, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rintro w ⟨hwK, v, rfl⟩
    have hv : v ∈ (LinearMap.ker (f ^ m)).comap f := hwK
    rw [hcomap] at hv
    exact ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  · rintro w ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, v, rfl⟩
    have : v ∈ (LinearMap.ker (f ^ m)).comap f := by rw [hcomap]; exact hv
    exact this

/-- **Proof of Corollary 4.11.**  If `U ≠ 0` it has a minimal support prime `𝔮`;
Lemma 4.8 makes the lengths finite, and Lemmas 4.9 and 4.10 contradict one
another.  Hence `U = M/x₁M = 0`. -/
theorem step_4_11_cokernel_zero (hN : 0 < N)
    (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
    Subsingleton (cokernelU k n N d) := by
  obtain ⟨hU, -, -, -⟩ := lemma_4_8 hform
  by_contra h
  have : Nontrivial (cokernelU k n N d) := not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp h
  obtain ⟨q, hqmem, hqmin⟩ :=
    AlgebraicAnalysis.MinimalSupportExistence.exists_minimal_support_prime
      (R := Tangential k n) (U := cokernelU k n N d)
  exact not_lt_of_ge (lemma_4_9 hform q hqmem hqmin) (lemma_4_10 hN hform q hqmem hqmin)

/-- Induction step of the first identity:
`x₁^{m+1}p^{m+1} = x₁(∏_{i<m}(E−i))p = (∏_{i<m}(E−1−i))x₁p = ∏_{i≤m}(E−i)`. -/
theorem step_4_1_falling_succ (x p : A) (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1) (m : ℕ)
    (ih : x ^ m * p ^ m = ((List.range m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p - i).prod) :
    x ^ (m + 1) * p ^ (m + 1) =
      ((List.range (m + 1)).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p - i).prod := by
  calc x ^ (m + 1) * p ^ (m + 1) = x * (x ^ m * p ^ m) * p := by
        rw [pow_succ', pow_succ]; simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = ((List.range m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p - 1 - i).prod * eulerElement x p := by
        rw [ih, step_4_1_coordinate_shift x p hweyl, mul_assoc]
    _ = eulerElement x p * ((List.range m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p - 1 - i).prod := by
        refine (Commute.list_prod_left _ _ fun y hy => ?_).eq
        obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
        exact ((Commute.refl _).sub_left (Commute.one_left _)).sub_left
          (Nat.cast_commute i _)
    _ = ((List.range (m + 1)).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p - i).prod := by
        rw [List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.map_map]
        congr 1
        · simp
        · congr 1
          refine List.map_congr_left fun i _ => ?_
          simp only [Function.comp_apply, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
          push_cast
          abel

        x ^ (m + 1) * p ^ (m + 1) = (List.map (fun i => x * p - ↑i) (List.range (m + 1))).prod

  (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1) (m : ℕ)
  (ih : p ^ m * x ^ m = (List.map (fun i => eulerElement x p + ↑i) (List.range' 1 m)).prod) :
  p ^ (m + 1) * x ^ (m + 1) =
    (List.map (fun i => eulerElement x p + ↑i) (List.range' 1 (m + 1))).prod
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_1_risin.source:
/-- Induction step of the second identity, from `Ep = p(E−1)`, i.e.
`pE = (E+1)p`:
`p^{m+1}x₁^{m+1} = p(∏_{i=1}^m(E+i))x₁ = (∏_{i=1}^m(E+1+i))px₁ = ∏_{i=1}^{m+1}(E+i)`. -/
theorem step_4_1_rising_succ (x p : A) (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1) (m : ℕ)
    (ih : p ^ m * x ^ m = ((List.range' 1 m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p + i).prod) :
    p ^ (m + 1) * x ^ (m + 1) =
      ((List.range' 1 (m + 1)).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p + i).prod := by
  have hpx : p * x = eulerElement x p + 1 := hweyl
  calc p ^ (m + 1) * x ^ (m + 1) = p * (p ^ m * x ^ m) * x := by
        rw [pow_succ', pow_succ]; simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = ((List.range' 1 m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p + 1 + i).prod *
          (eulerElement x p + 1) := by
        rw [ih, step_4_1_momentum_shift x p hweyl, mul_assoc, hpx]
    _ = (eulerElement x p + 1) *
          ((List.range' 1 m).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p + 1 + i).prod := by
        refine (Commute.list_prod_left _ _ fun y hy => ?_).eq
        obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
        exact (Commute.refl (eulerElement x p + 1)).add_left (Nat.cast_commute i _)
    _ = ((List.range' 1 (m + 1)).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p + i).prod := by
        rw [List.range'_succ, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
        congr 1
        · simp
        · rw [List.range'_eq_map_range, List.range'_eq_map_range, List.map_map,
            List.map_map]
          congr 1
          refine List.map_congr_left fun i _ => ?_
          simp only [Function.comp_apply]
          push_cast
          rw [add_assoc _ 1, ← add_assoc 1 1, one_add_one_eq_two]

        p ^ (m + 1) * x ^ (m + 1) = (List.map (fun i => x * p + ↑i) (List.range' 1 (m + 1))).prod

**First paragraph of the proof of Lemma 4.2.**  By Lemma 4.1 (the
hypothesis `h41`, the product identities for `m = N`) and the extended Euclidean
algorithm in `ℚ[E]` there are `u, v ∈ ℚ[E]` with
`p^N x₁^N u(E) + x₁^N p^N v(E) = 1`.

  (N : ℕ)
  (h41 :
    1 ≤ N →
      x ^ N * p ^ N = (List.map (fun i => eulerElement x p - ↑i) (List.range N)).prod ∧
        p ^ N * x ^ N = (List.map (fun i => eulerElement x p + ↑i) (List.range' 1 N)).prod) :
  ∃ u v,
    p ^ N * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_bezou.source:
/-- **First paragraph of the proof of Lemma 4.2.**  By Lemma 4.1 (the
hypothesis `h41`, the product identities for `m = N`) and the extended Euclidean
algorithm in `ℚ[E]` there are `u, v ∈ ℚ[E]` with
`p^N x₁^N u(E) + x₁^N p^N v(E) = 1`. -/
theorem step_4_2_bezout (x p : A) (N : ℕ)
    (h41 : 1 ≤ N →
      x ^ N * p ^ N = ((List.range N).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p - i).prod ∧
        p ^ N * x ^ N = ((List.range' 1 N).map fun i : ℕ => eulerElement x p + i).prod) :
    ∃ u v : Polynomial ℚ,
      (p ^ N * x ^ N) * eulerPolynomialEval x p u +
        (x ^ N * p ^ N) * eulerPolynomialEval x p v = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := step_4_2_coprime N
  refine ⟨u, v, ?_⟩
  rw [mul_comm u, mul_comm v] at huv
  have h := congrArg (eulerPolynomialEval x p) huv
  rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_one] at h
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with rfl | hN
  · simpa [add_comm] using h
  obtain ⟨hminus, hplus⟩ := h41 hN
  rw [(step_4_2_eval_products x p N).1, (step_4_2_eval_products x p N).2,
    ← hplus, ← hminus] at h
  exact h

        p ^ N * x ^ N = (List.map (fun i => x * p + ↑i) (List.range' 1 N)).prod) →
    ∃ u v,
      p ^ N * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
          x ^ N * p ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v =
        1

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_copri.doc:
`R_+(E) = ∏_{r=1}^N (E+r)` and `R_-(E) = ∏_{r=0}^{N-1}(E−r)` have the disjoint
root sets `{−1,…,−N}` and `{0,…,N−1}`, so `gcd(R_+, R_-) = 1` in `ℚ[E]`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_coprime (N : ℕ) :
  IsCoprime (List.map (fun r => Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑r) (List.range' 1 N)).prod

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_copri.source:
/-- `R_+(E) = ∏_{r=1}^N (E+r)` and `R_-(E) = ∏_{r=0}^{N-1}(E−r)` have the disjoint
root sets `{−1,…,−N}` and `{0,…,N−1}`, so `gcd(R_+, R_-) = 1` in `ℚ[E]`. -/
theorem step_4_2_coprime (N : ℕ) :
    IsCoprime
      ((List.range' 1 N).map fun r : ℕ => (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (r : ℚ))).prod
      ((List.range N).map fun r : ℕ => (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (r : ℚ))).prod := by
  apply isCoprime_list_prod
  intro a ha b hb
  obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
  obtain ⟨s, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hb
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := (List.mem_range'_1.mp hr).1
  have hunit : IsUnit (-(r : ℚ) - s) := by
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    have : (1 : ℚ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr1
    have : (0 : ℚ) ≤ s := by positivity
    linarith
  have := Polynomial.isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub hunit
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using this

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_posit.doc:
**Third paragraph.**  Every term of `w` has positive Euler degree, hence
`w = u₀ x₁` with `u₀ ∈ A_{≥0}`.  The input is that `Σ x₁^N` and `x₁^N Σ` lie in
`A_{≥0} x₁` (positive Euler degree of `Σ x₁^N` and `x₁^N Σ`, supplied for the
presented `d̃` by `step_4_2_presented_remainder`); `u(E), v(E)` have degree zero
and pass to the left of `x₁` by normality.

  (C : Subring A) (x p sigma : A) (N : ℕ) (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1)
  (hcomm : ∀ (c : ↥C), x * ↑c = ↑c * x) (hscalar : ∀ (q : ℚ), (algebraMap ℚ A) q ∈ C) (U V : A)
  (hU : U ∈ nonnegativePart C x p) (hV : V ∈ nonnegativePart C x p) (hright : sigma * x ^ N = U * x)
  (hleft : x ^ N * sigma = V * x) (u v : Polynomial ℚ) :
  ∃ u₀ ∈ nonnegativePart C x p,
    sigma * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
        x ^ N * sigma * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v =
      u₀ * x
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_posit.source:
/-- **Third paragraph.**  Every term of `w` has positive Euler degree, hence
`w = u₀ x₁` with `u₀ ∈ A_{≥0}`.  The input is that `Σ x₁^N` and `x₁^N Σ` lie in
`A_{≥0} x₁` (positive Euler degree of `Σ x₁^N` and `x₁^N Σ`, supplied for the
presented `d̃` by `step_4_2_presented_remainder`); `u(E), v(E)` have degree zero
and pass to the left of `x₁` by normality. -/
theorem step_4_2_positive (C : Subring A) (x p sigma : A) (N : ℕ)
    (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1)
    (hcomm : ∀ c : C, x * (c : A) = (c : A) * x)
    (hscalar : ∀ q : ℚ, algebraMap ℚ A q ∈ C)
    (U V : A) (hU : U ∈ nonnegativePart C x p) (hV : V ∈ nonnegativePart C x p)
    (hright : sigma * x ^ N = U * x) (hleft : x ^ N * sigma = V * x)
    (u v : Polynomial ℚ) :
    ∃ u₀ ∈ nonnegativePart C x p,
      (sigma * x ^ N) * eulerPolynomialEval x p u +
        (x ^ N * sigma) * eulerPolynomialEval x p v = u₀ * x := by
  obtain ⟨su, hsu⟩ := coordinate_mul_eulerPolynomial C x p hweyl hcomm hscalar u
  obtain ⟨sv, hsv⟩ := coordinate_mul_eulerPolynomial C x p hweyl hcomm hscalar v
  refine ⟨U * su + V * sv,
    Subring.add_mem _ (Subring.mul_mem _ hU su.2) (Subring.mul_mem _ hV sv.2), ?_⟩
  rw [hright, hleft, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hsu, hsv]
  noncomm_ring

∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] [inst_1 : Algebra ℚ A] (C : Subring A) (x p sigma : A) (N : ℕ),
  p * x = x * p + 1 →
    (∀ (c : ↥C), x * ↑c = ↑c * x) →
      (∀ (q : ℚ), (algebraMap ℚ A) q ∈ C) →
        ∀ (U V : A),
          U ∈ Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {x, x * p}) →
            V ∈ Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {x, x * p}) →
              sigma * x ^ N = U * x →
                x ^ N * sigma = V * x →
                  ∀ (u v : Polynomial ℚ),
                    ∃ u₀ ∈ Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {x, x * p}),
                      sigma * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
                          x ^ N * sigma * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v =
                        u₀ * x

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_prese.doc:
**Positivity of the remainder for `d̃`.**  For the normalized `d̃` with
`d̃ = p^N + Σ`, both `Σ x₁^N` and `x₁^N Σ` lie in `A_{≥0} x₁`.  The paper argues by
Euler degree of the terms `p^j x₁^l b` (`j < N`); Lean writes `Σ` in the PBW
basis of the Ore tower and factors each monomial `b x₁^a p^j` with `j < N`
(`presentedRemainder_hasPositiveCoordinateFactor`), then transports back.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_prese.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_presented_remainder.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [Algebra ℚ k]
  {n N : ℕ} {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
  (hd : WeylPBWMonicBridge.IsPBWMonicAt k (Sum.inr 0) N d) :
  ∃ U ∈ presentedNonnegativePart k n,
    ∃ V ∈ presentedNonnegativePart k n,
      (d - WeylIteratedEquivalence.presentedMomentum k n ^ N) *
            WeylIteratedEquivalence.presentedCoordinate k n ^ N =
          U * WeylIteratedEquivalence.presentedCoordinate k n ∧
        WeylIteratedEquivalence.presentedCoordinate k n ^ N *
            (d - WeylIteratedEquivalence.presentedMomentum k n ^ N) =
          V * WeylIteratedEquivalence.presentedCoordinate k n
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_prese.source:
/-- **Positivity of the remainder for `d̃`.**  For the normalized `d̃` with
`d̃ = p^N + Σ`, both `Σ x₁^N` and `x₁^N Σ` lie in `A_{≥0} x₁`.  The paper argues by
Euler degree of the terms `p^j x₁^l b` (`j < N`); Lean writes `Σ` in the PBW
basis of the Ore tower and factors each monomial `b x₁^a p^j` with `j < N`
(`presentedRemainder_hasPositiveCoordinateFactor`), then transports back. -/
theorem step_4_2_presented_remainder {N : ℕ} {d : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hd : IsPBWMonicAt k (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1))) N d) :
    ∃ U ∈ presentedNonnegativePart k n, ∃ V ∈ presentedNonnegativePart k n,
      (d - presentedMomentum k n ^ N) * presentedCoordinate k n ^ N =
          U * presentedCoordinate k n ∧
        presentedCoordinate k n ^ N * (d - presentedMomentum k n ^ N) =
          V * presentedCoordinate k n := by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV⟩ := presentedRemainder_hasPositiveCoordinateFactor k n N hd
  obtain ⟨σ, hσdef⟩ : ∃ σ : PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n),
      σ = presentedToIterated k (n + 1) d - stageMomentum k n ^ N := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hU' : σ * pairCoordinate ^ N = (U : PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n)) *
      pairCoordinate := by rw [hσdef]; exact hU
  have hV' : pairCoordinate ^ N * σ = (V : PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n)) *
      pairCoordinate := by rw [hσdef]; exact hV
  have hσ : fromIterated k n σ = d - presentedMomentum k n ^ N := by
    rw [hσdef]
    change (presentedIteratedEquiv k (n + 1)).symm
      (presentedIteratedEquiv k (n + 1) d - stageMomentum k n ^ N) = _
    rw [map_sub, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_pow]
    congr 2
    exact fromIterated_momentum k n
  refine ⟨fromIterated k n U, iterated_eulerSubring_le k n U U.2,
    fromIterated k n V, iterated_eulerSubring_le k n V V.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := congrArg (fromIterated k n) hU'
    rw [RingHom.map_mul (fromIterated k n) σ] at h
    rw [RingHom.map_mul (fromIterated k n) (U : PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n))] at h
    rw [RingHom.map_pow (fromIterated k n) pairCoordinate N] at h
    rw [hσ, fromIterated_coordinate] at h
    exact h
  · have h := congrArg (fromIterated k n) hV'
    rw [RingHom.map_mul (fromIterated k n) _ σ] at h
    rw [RingHom.map_mul (fromIterated k n) (V : PairStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n))] at h
    rw [RingHom.map_pow (fromIterated k n) pairCoordinate N] at h
    rw [hσ, fromIterated_coordinate] at h
    exact h

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_resid.doc:
**Second paragraph.**  With `d̃ = p^N + Σ`,
`(d̃ x₁^N) u(E) + (x₁^N d̃) v(E) = 1 + w ∈ 𝓘`, where
`w = Σ x₁^N u(E) + x₁^N Σ v(E)` and `𝓘 = d̃A + x₁^N d̃A`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_residue.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] [Algebra ℚ A]
  (x p d sigma : A) (N : ℕ) (u v : Polynomial ℚ) (hd : d = p ^ N + sigma)
  (hbezout :
    p ^ N * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
        x ^ N * p ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v =
      1) :
  d * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
        x ^ N * d * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v =
      1 +
        (sigma * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
          x ^ N * sigma * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v) ∧
    1 +
        (sigma * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
          x ^ N * sigma * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v) ∈
      WeylEulerResidue.canonicalRightIdeal x d N
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_2_resid.source:
/-- **Second paragraph.**  With `d̃ = p^N + Σ`,
`(d̃ x₁^N) u(E) + (x₁^N d̃) v(E) = 1 + w ∈ 𝓘`, where
`w = Σ x₁^N u(E) + x₁^N Σ v(E)` and `𝓘 = d̃A + x₁^N d̃A`. -/
theorem step_4_2_residue (x p d sigma : A) (N : ℕ) (u v : Polynomial ℚ)
    (hd : d = p ^ N + sigma)
    (hbezout : (p ^ N * x ^ N) * eulerPolynomialEval x p u +
        (x ^ N * p ^ N) * eulerPolynomialEval x p v = 1) :
    (d * x ^ N) * eulerPolynomialEval x p u + (x ^ N * d) * eulerPolynomialEval x p v =
        1 + ((sigma * x ^ N) * eulerPolynomialEval x p u +
          (x ^ N * sigma) * eulerPolynomialEval x p v) ∧
      1 + ((sigma * x ^ N) * eulerPolynomialEval x p u +
          (x ^ N * sigma) * eulerPolynomialEval x p v) ∈ canonicalRightIdeal x d N := by
  have hid := positiveEulerResidue_identity x p d sigma
    (eulerPolynomialEval x p u) (eulerPolynomialEval x p v) N hd hbezout
  rw [← mul_assoc] at hid
  refine ⟨hid, ?_⟩
  rw [← hid]
  refine (canonicalRightIdeal x d N).add_mem ?_ ?_
  · rw [mul_assoc]
    change MulOpposite.op (x ^ N * eulerPolynomialEval x p u) • d ∈
      canonicalRightIdeal x d N
    exact (canonicalRightIdeal x d N).smul_mem _ (firstGenerator_mem x d N)
  · change MulOpposite.op (eulerPolynomialEval x p v) • (x ^ N * d) ∈
      canonicalRightIdeal x d N
    exact (canonicalRightIdeal x d N).smul_mem _ (secondGenerator_mem x d N)

∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] [inst_1 : Algebra ℚ A] (x p d sigma : A) (N : ℕ)
  (u v : Polynomial ℚ),
  d = p ^ N + sigma →
    p ^ N * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
          x ^ N * p ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v =
        1 →
      d * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
            x ^ N * d * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v =
          1 +
            (sigma * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
              x ^ N * sigma * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v) ∧
        1 +
            (sigma * x ^ N * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) u +
              x ^ N * sigma * (Stafford.eulerPolynomialEval x p) v) ∈
          Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ {d, x ^ N * d}

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_class.doc: **`qA_{≥0} = Q`.**  `qA_{≥0}` is stable under `C` and `p`, which generate `A`.

  (hC : ∀ c ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ classSet I R, EulerSurjectivity.rightMul I c z ∈ classSet I R)
  (hp : ∀ z ∈ classSet I R, EulerSurjectivity.rightMul I p z ∈ classSet I R)

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_class.source:
/-- **`qA_{≥0} = Q`.**  `qA_{≥0}` is stable under `C` and `p`, which generate `A`. -/
theorem step_4_3_classSet_eq_univ (C : Subring A) (p : A)
    (hC : ∀ c ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ classSet I R, rightMul I c z ∈ classSet I R)
    (hp : ∀ z ∈ classSet I R, rightMul I p z ∈ classSet I R)
    (hgenerate : Subring.closure ((C : Set A) ∪ {p}) = ⊤) :
    classSet I R = Set.univ := by
  have htop : classSetStabilizer I R = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hgenerate]
    apply Subring.closure_le.2
    rintro a (ha | ha)
    · exact hC a ha
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha]
      exact hp
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro z
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective I z
  have ha : a ∈ classSetStabilizer I R := htop ▸ Subring.mem_top a
  have h := ha (qmk I 1) ⟨1, R.one_mem, rfl⟩
  rwa [← qmk_right_mul, one_mul] at h
