∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] {I : Submodule Aᵐᵒᵖ A} {R : Subring A} (C : Subring A) (p : A),
  (∀ c ∈ C,
      ∀ z ∈ {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r},
        MulOpposite.op c • z ∈ {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r}) →
    (∀ z ∈ {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r},
        MulOpposite.op p • z ∈ {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r}) →
      Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {p}) = ⊤ → {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r} = Set.univ

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_norma.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_normal_surj.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A]
  {I : EulerSurjectivity.RightIdeal A} {R : Subring A} (x u₀ : A) (hx : x ∈ R) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ R)
  (hres : 1 + u₀ * x ∈ I) (hnormal : ∀ r ∈ R, ∃ r' ∈ R, x * r = r' * x) :
  classSet I R = EulerSurjectivity.rightMul I x '' classSet I R
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_norma.source:
/-- **Equation (normal-surj): `qA_{≥0} = (qA_{≥0})x₁`.**  `⊇` because `x₁ ∈ A_{≥0}`;
`⊆` because `qr = −(qu₀)x₁r = −(qu₀r')x₁` for `x₁r = r'x₁`. -/
theorem step_4_3_normal_surj (x u₀ : A) (hx : x ∈ R) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ R)
    (hres : 1 + u₀ * x ∈ I)
    (hnormal : ∀ r ∈ R, ∃ r' ∈ R, x * r = r' * x) :
    classSet I R = rightMul I x '' classSet I R := by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨r', hr', hxr⟩ := hnormal r hr
    refine ⟨qmk I (-(u₀ * r')), ⟨_, R.neg_mem (R.mul_mem hu₀ hr'), rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc rightMul I x (qmk I (-(u₀ * r'))) = qmk I (-u₀ * (r' * x)) := by
          rw [← qmk_right_mul]; congr 1; noncomm_ring
      _ = qmk I (-u₀ * x * r) := by rw [← hxr, mul_assoc]
      _ = rightMul I r (rightMul I x (qmk I (-u₀))) := by
          rw [← qmk_right_mul, ← qmk_right_mul]
      _ = qmk I r := by rw [← step_4_3_q_mem x u₀ hres, ← qmk_right_mul, one_mul]
  · rintro ⟨w, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨r * x, R.mul_mem hr hx, (qmk_right_mul I r x).symm⟩
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_norma.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] {I : Submodule Aᵐᵒᵖ A} {R : Subring A} (x u₀ : A),
  x ∈ R →
    u₀ ∈ R →
      1 + u₀ * x ∈ I →
        (∀ r ∈ R, ∃ r' ∈ R, x * r = r' * x) →
          {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r} =
            (fun q => MulOpposite.op x • q) '' {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r}

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_q_mem.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_q_mem.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A]
  {I : EulerSurjectivity.RightIdeal A} (x u₀ : A) (hres : 1 + u₀ * x ∈ I) :
  EulerSurjectivity.qmk I 1 = EulerSurjectivity.rightMul I x (EulerSurjectivity.qmk I (-u₀))
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_q_mem.source:
/-- **`q ∈ (qA_{≥0})x₁`.**  From `1 + u₀x₁ ∈ 𝓘`, `q = −q u₀ x₁`. -/
theorem step_4_3_q_mem (x u₀ : A) (hres : 1 + u₀ * x ∈ I) :
    qmk I 1 = rightMul I x (qmk I (-u₀)) := by
  rw [← qmk_right_mul]
  refine ((Submodule.Quotient.eq I).2 ?_).symm
  convert I.neg_mem hres using 1
  noncomm_ring
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_q_mem.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] {I : Submodule Aᵐᵒᵖ A} (x u₀ : A),
  1 + u₀ * x ∈ I → Submodule.Quotient.mk 1 = MulOpposite.op x • Submodule.Quotient.mk (-u₀)

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_stabl.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_stable_coefficients.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A]
  {I : EulerSurjectivity.RightIdeal A} {R : Subring A} (C : Subring A) (hC : C ≤ R) (c : A) :
  c ∈ C → ∀ z ∈ classSet I R, EulerSurjectivity.rightMul I c z ∈ classSet I R
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_stabl.source:
/-- **Stability under `C`.**  `C = A_{n-1}[x₁] ⊆ A_{≥0}`. -/
theorem step_4_3_stable_coefficients (C : Subring A) (hC : C ≤ R) :
    ∀ c ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ classSet I R, rightMul I c z ∈ classSet I R := by
  rintro c hc _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨r * c, R.mul_mem hr (hC hc), (qmk_right_mul I r c).symm⟩
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_stabl.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] {I : Submodule Aᵐᵒᵖ A} {R : Subring A},
  ∀ C ≤ R,
    ∀ c ∈ C,
      ∀ z ∈ {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r},
        MulOpposite.op c • z ∈ {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r}

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_stabl.doc:
**Stability under `p`.**  If `m = m'x₁` with `m' ∈ qA_{≥0}`, then
`mp = m'(x₁p) = m'E ∈ qA_{≥0}`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_stabl.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_stable_momentum.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A]
  {I : EulerSurjectivity.RightIdeal A} {R : Subring A} (x p : A) (hE : x * p ∈ R)
  (hsurj : classSet I R = EulerSurjectivity.rightMul I x '' classSet I R)
  (z : EulerSurjectivity.RightQuotient I) :
  z ∈ classSet I R → EulerSurjectivity.rightMul I p z ∈ classSet I R
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_stabl.source:
/-- **Stability under `p`.**  If `m = m'x₁` with `m' ∈ qA_{≥0}`, then
`mp = m'(x₁p) = m'E ∈ qA_{≥0}`. -/
theorem step_4_3_stable_momentum (x p : A) (hE : x * p ∈ R)
    (hsurj : classSet I R = rightMul I x '' classSet I R) :
    ∀ z ∈ classSet I R, rightMul I p z ∈ classSet I R := by
  intro z hz
  rw [hsurj] at hz
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨r * (x * p), R.mul_mem hr hE, ?_⟩
  rw [← qmk_right_mul, ← qmk_right_mul, mul_assoc]
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_3_stabl.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] {I : Submodule Aᵐᵒᵖ A} {R : Subring A} (x p : A),
  x * p ∈ R →
    {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r} =
        (fun q => MulOpposite.op x • q) '' {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r} →
      ∀ z ∈ {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r},
        MulOpposite.op p • z ∈ {z | ∃ r ∈ R, z = Submodule.Quotient.mk r}

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_eq.doc: `s ∉ 𝔭` is invertible in `N_𝔭`, so `y/s = 0 ↔ y/1 = 0`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_eq.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_eq_zero_iff.{u_1, u_2} {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R]
  {N : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (p : PrimeSpectrum R) (y : N)
  (s : ↥p.asIdeal.primeCompl) : LocalizedModule.mk y s = 0 ↔ LocalizedModule.mk y 1 = 0
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_eq.source:
/-- `s ∉ 𝔭` is invertible in `N_𝔭`, so `y/s = 0 ↔ y/1 = 0`. -/
theorem step_4_7_mk_eq_zero_iff (p : PrimeSpectrum R) (y : N) (s : p.asIdeal.primeCompl) :
    LocalizedModule.mk y s = 0 ↔ LocalizedModule.mk y (1 : p.asIdeal.primeCompl) = 0 := by
  have h : LocalizedModule.mk y s =
      (IsLocalization.mk' (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) (1 : R) s) •
        LocalizedModule.mk y (1 : p.asIdeal.primeCompl) := by
    rw [← Localization.mk_eq_mk', LocalizedModule.mk_smul_mk, one_smul, mul_one]
  rw [h]
  constructor
  · intro h0
    have := congrArg (fun z => (algebraMap R (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) s) • z) h0
    simp only [smul_zero, smul_smul] at this
    rwa [IsLocalization.mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul, mul_one, IsLocalization.mk'_self,
      one_smul] at this
  · intro h0
    rw [h0, smul_zero]

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_on.doc:
In `N_𝔭`, `y/1 = 0` iff some `u ∉ 𝔭` kills `y`, i.e. iff
`Ann_R(y) ⊄ 𝔭`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_on.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_one_eq_zero_iff.{u_1, u_2} {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R]
  {N : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (p : PrimeSpectrum R) (y : N) :
  LocalizedModule.mk y 1 = 0 ↔ ¬(R ∙ y).annihilator ≤ p.asIdeal
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_on.source:
/-- In `N_𝔭`, `y/1 = 0` iff some `u ∉ 𝔭` kills `y`, i.e. iff
`Ann_R(y) ⊄ 𝔭`. -/
theorem step_4_7_mk_one_eq_zero_iff (p : PrimeSpectrum R) (y : N) :
    LocalizedModule.mk y (1 : p.asIdeal.primeCompl) = 0 ↔
      ¬ (R ∙ y).annihilator ≤ p.asIdeal := by
  rw [← LocalizedModule.zero_mk (1 : p.asIdeal.primeCompl),
    (definition_4_4 p.asIdeal.primeCompl (N := N)).2.1]
  simp only [one_smul, smul_zero, sub_zero, IsConcreteLE.le_iff,
    Submodule.mem_annihilator_span_singleton, not_forall]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, h⟩
    exact ⟨u, h, hu⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, h, hu⟩
    exact ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, h⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_on.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_one_ne_zero_iff.{u_1, u_2} {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R]
  {N : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (p : PrimeSpectrum R) (y : N) :
  LocalizedModule.mk y 1 ≠ 0 ↔ (R ∙ y).annihilator ≤ p.asIdeal
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_7_mk_on.source:
/-- The contrapositive: `y/1 ≠ 0 ↔ Ann_R(y) ⊆ 𝔭`. -/
theorem step_4_7_mk_one_ne_zero_iff (p : PrimeSpectrum R) (y : N) :
    LocalizedModule.mk y (1 : p.asIdeal.primeCompl) ≠ 0 ↔
      (R ∙ y).annihilator ≤ p.asIdeal := by
  rw [ne_eq, step_4_7_mk_one_eq_zero_iff, not_not]

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_finit.doc:
**First paragraph: `U` and `V` are finite over `T`.**  `M = gr Q` is finite
over `T[x₁]` because `P` annihilates `M` and is monic of degree `N` in `ξ₁`
(`canonical_orderAssociatedGradedModule_finite_normalCoeffRing`); `V` and `U` are
then finite over `T[x₁]` and, being killed by `x₁`, over `T`
(`canonical_finite_old_coordinate_kernel_cokernel`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_finit.source:
/-- **First paragraph: `U` and `V` are finite over `T`.**  `M = gr Q` is finite
over `T[x₁]` because `P` annihilates `M` and is monic of degree `N` in `ξ₁`
(`canonical_orderAssociatedGradedModule_finite_normalCoeffRing`); `V` and `U` are
then finite over `T[x₁]` and, being killed by `x₁`, over `T`
(`canonical_finite_old_coordinate_kernel_cokernel`). -/
theorem step_4_8_finite (hd : IsPBWMonicAt k (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1))) N d) :
    Module.Finite (Tangential k n) (cokernelU k n N d) ∧
      Module.Finite (Tangential k n) (kernelV k n N d) :=
  (canonical_finite_old_coordinate_kernel_cokernel hd).symm

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_finit.doc:
**Third paragraph.**  At a minimal prime `𝔮` of `Supp_T U`, the supports of
`U_𝔮` and `V_𝔮` are contained in `{𝔮T_𝔮}` (for `V` by `Supp V ⊆ Supp U`), so
both have finite length over `T_𝔮` (`V_𝔮` possibly zero).
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_finit.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_finite_length.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {R : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2}
  {V : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [AddCommGroup U] [Module R U] [Module.Finite R U]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] [Module.Finite R V]
  (hsupp : Module.support R V ⊆ Module.support R U) (q : PrimeSpectrum R)
  (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support R U)
  (hq : ∀ p ∈ Module.support R U, p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
  IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl) (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl U) ∧
    IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl) (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl V)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_finit.source:
/-- **Third paragraph.**  At a minimal prime `𝔮` of `Supp_T U`, the supports of
`U_𝔮` and `V_𝔮` are contained in `{𝔮T_𝔮}` (for `V` by `Supp V ⊆ Supp U`), so
both have finite length over `T_𝔮` (`V_𝔮` possibly zero). -/
theorem step_4_8_finite_length {R U V : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module R U] [Module.Finite R U]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] [Module.Finite R V]
    (hsupp : Module.support R V ⊆ Module.support R U) (q : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support R U)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ Module.support R U, p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl U) ∧
      IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl V) := by
  refine ⟨step_4_8_localized_isFiniteLength q hqmem hq, ?_⟩
  by_cases hk : q ∈ Module.support R V
  · exact step_4_8_localized_isFiniteLength q hk fun p hp hpq => hq p (hsupp hp) hpq
  · have : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl V) :=
      Module.notMem_support_iff.mp hk
    exact IsFiniteLength.of_subsingleton

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_local.doc:
A minimal prime of `Supp_T L` (`L` finite over the Noetherian `T`) is minimal
over `Ann_T L`, since `Supp L = V(Ann L)` [Stacks 00L2], so `L_𝔮` has finite
length [Atiyah–Macdonald 8.5, Stacks 00KH].
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_local.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_localized_isFiniteLength.{u_1, u_2} {R : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2}
  [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L] [Module.Finite R L]
  (q : PrimeSpectrum R) (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support R L)
  (hq : ∀ p ∈ Module.support R L, p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
  IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl) (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl L)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_local.source:
/-- A minimal prime of `Supp_T L` (`L` finite over the Noetherian `T`) is minimal
over `Ann_T L`, since `Supp L = V(Ann L)` [Stacks 00L2], so `L_𝔮` has finite
length [Atiyah–Macdonald 8.5, Stacks 00KH]. -/
theorem step_4_8_localized_isFiniteLength {R L : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L] [Module.Finite R L] (q : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hqmem : q ∈ Module.support R L)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ Module.support R L, p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → q.asIdeal ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    IsFiniteLength (Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl L) := by
  have hmin : q.asIdeal ∈ (Module.annihilator R L).minimalPrimes := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpq⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le
      (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hqmem)
    have hp' : (⟨p, hp.1.1⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R) ∈ Module.support R L :=
      Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mpr hp.1.2
    have heq : p = q.asIdeal := le_antisymm hpq (hq _ hp' hpq)
    simpa [heq] using hp
  exact AlgebraicAnalysis.MinimalPrimeFiniteLengthLocalization.localizedModule_isFiniteLength
    q.asIdeal hmin

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_suppo.doc:
**Second paragraph: `Supp_T V ⊆ Supp_T U`.**  For `𝔭 ∈ Supp_T V` pick `v` with
`Ann_T(v) ⊆ 𝔭` (Lemma 4.7); `Ann_{k[x,ξ]}(v)` misses `S = T∖𝔭`, so lies in a prime
`𝔔` with `𝔔 ∩ S = ∅`; `𝔔 ∈ Supp(ker f)` (Lemma 4.7), hence `𝔔 ∈ Supp(coker f)`
(Vasconcelos), so some `u ∈ U` has `Ann(u) ⊆ 𝔔` (Lemma 4.7), whence
`Ann_T(u) ⊆ 𝔭` and `𝔭 ∈ Supp_T U` (Lemma 4.7).
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_suppo.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_support_inclusion.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {R : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2}
  {E : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C] [AddCommGroup E] [Module C E] [Module R E]
  [IsScalarTower R C E] [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (f : Module.End C E) :
  Module.support R ↥(↑R f).ker ⊆ Module.support R (E ⧸ (↑R f).range)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_suppo.source:
/-- **Second paragraph: `Supp_T V ⊆ Supp_T U`.**  For `𝔭 ∈ Supp_T V` pick `v` with
`Ann_T(v) ⊆ 𝔭` (Lemma 4.7); `Ann_{k[x,ξ]}(v)` misses `S = T∖𝔭`, so lies in a prime
`𝔔` with `𝔔 ∩ S = ∅`; `𝔔 ∈ Supp(ker f)` (Lemma 4.7), hence `𝔔 ∈ Supp(coker f)`
(Vasconcelos), so some `u ∈ U` has `Ann(u) ⊆ 𝔔` (Lemma 4.7), whence
`Ann_T(u) ⊆ 𝔭` and `𝔭 ∈ Supp_T U` (Lemma 4.7). -/
theorem step_4_8_support_inclusion {R C E : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module C E] [Module R E] [IsScalarTower R C E]
    [IsNoetherianRing C] [Module.Finite C E] (f : Module.End C E) :
    Module.support R (LinearMap.ker (f.restrictScalars R)) ⊆
      Module.support R (E ⧸ LinearMap.range (f.restrictScalars R)) := by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (lemma_4_7 p).mp hp
  let vC : LinearMap.ker f := ⟨v.1, v.2⟩
  let I : Ideal C := (C ∙ vC).annihilator
  have hdisj : Disjoint (I : Set C) (p.asIdeal.primeCompl.map (algebraMap R C)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro c hc ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    have hrv : r • v = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change r • v.1 = 0
      have hcv : algebraMap R C r • vC = 0 :=
        (Submodule.mem_annihilator_span_singleton _ _).mp hc
      simpa [vC, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul C r v.1] using congrArg Subtype.val hcv
    exact hr (hv ((Submodule.mem_annihilator_span_singleton _ _).mpr hrv))
  obtain ⟨Q, hQprime, hIQ, hQdisj⟩ := I.exists_le_prime_disjoint _ hdisj
  let Q' : PrimeSpectrum C := ⟨Q, hQprime⟩
  have hQker : Q' ∈ Module.support C (LinearMap.ker f) := (lemma_4_7 Q').mpr ⟨vC, hIQ⟩
  have hQcoker := step_4_8_vasconcelos f hQker
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (lemma_4_7 Q').mp hQcoker
  refine (lemma_4_7 p).mpr ⟨u, fun r hr => ?_⟩
  have hmap : algebraMap R C r ∈ (C ∙ u).annihilator := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_annihilator_span_singleton]
    have hru : r • u = 0 := (Submodule.mem_annihilator_span_singleton _ _).mp hr
    simpa [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul C r u] using hru
  by_contra hrp
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hQdisj (hu hmap) ⟨r, hrp, rfl⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_vasco.doc:
**Vasconcelos paragraph.**  For a finite module `M` over a commutative
Noetherian ring `C` and `f ∈ End_C M`, `Supp_C(ker f) ⊆ Supp_C(coker f)`: if
`(coker f)_𝔔 = coker(f_𝔔) = 0`, then `f_𝔔` is a surjective endomorphism of a finite
module, hence injective, and `(ker f)_𝔔 = ker(f_𝔔) = 0`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_vasco.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_vasconcelos.{u_1, u_2} {C : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [CommRing C]
  [IsNoetherianRing C] [AddCommGroup E] [Module C E] [Module.Finite C E] (f : Module.End C E) :
  Module.support C ↥(LinearMap.ker f) ⊆ Module.support C (E ⧸ LinearMap.range f)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_8_vasco.source:
/-- **Vasconcelos paragraph.**  For a finite module `M` over a commutative
Noetherian ring `C` and `f ∈ End_C M`, `Supp_C(ker f) ⊆ Supp_C(coker f)`: if
`(coker f)_𝔔 = coker(f_𝔔) = 0`, then `f_𝔔` is a surjective endomorphism of a finite
module, hence injective, and `(ker f)_𝔔 = ker(f_𝔔) = 0`. -/
theorem step_4_8_vasconcelos {C E : Type*} [CommRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module C E] [Module.Finite C E] (f : Module.End C E) :
    Module.support C (LinearMap.ker f) ⊆ Module.support C (E ⧸ LinearMap.range f) := by
  intro Q hQ
  by_contra hc
  let S := Q.asIdeal.primeCompl
  have hzero : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule S (E ⧸ LinearMap.range f)) :=
    Module.notMem_support_iff.mp hc
  -- exactness of localization: `(coker f)_𝔔 = coker(f_𝔔)`
  have hexc := (definition_4_4 S).2.2 f (LinearMap.range f).mkQ
    (LinearMap.exact_map_mkQ_range f)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (LocalizedModule.map S f) := by
    intro z
    exact (hexc z).mp (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  -- Vasconcelos: a surjective endomorphism of a finite module is injective
  have hinj : Function.Injective (LocalizedModule.map S f) :=
    IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_endomorphism _ hsurj
  -- exactness again: `(ker f)_𝔔 = ker(f_𝔔) = 0`
  have hexk := (definition_4_4 S).2.2 (LinearMap.ker f).subtype f
    (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map f)
  have hsub : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule S (LinearMap.ker f)) := by
    refine ⟨fun a b => LocalizedModule.map_injective S _ (Submodule.subtype_injective _) ?_⟩
    have ha : LocalizedModule.map S f (LocalizedModule.map S (LinearMap.ker f).subtype a) =
        LocalizedModule.map S f (LocalizedModule.map S (LinearMap.ker f).subtype b) := by
      rw [hexk.apply_apply_eq_zero, hexk.apply_apply_eq_zero]
    exact hinj ha
  exact Module.notMem_support_iff.mpr hsub hQ

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_addit.doc:
**Equation (additivity).**  `0 → A_{r+1} → A_r → B_r → B_{r+1} → 0` splits at
`im d_r` into two short exact sequences; additivity of length (Definition 4.6)
gives `ℓ(B_r) + ℓ(A_{r+1}) = ℓ(A_r) + ℓ(B_{r+1})`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_addit.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_additivity.{v, u_4} {R : Type u_4} [Ring R]
  {A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ : Type v} [AddCommGroup A₀] [Module R A₀] [AddCommGroup A₁] [Module R A₁]
  [AddCommGroup B₀] [Module R B₀] [AddCommGroup B₁] [Module R B₁] (d : A₀ →ₗ[R] B₀)
  (es : A₁ ≃ₗ[R] ↥d.ker) (et : B₁ ≃ₗ[R] B₀ ⧸ d.range) :
  Module.length R B₀ + Module.length R A₁ = Module.length R A₀ + Module.length R B₁
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_addit.source:
/-- **Equation (additivity).**  `0 → A_{r+1} → A_r → B_r → B_{r+1} → 0` splits at
`im d_r` into two short exact sequences; additivity of length (Definition 4.6)
gives `ℓ(B_r) + ℓ(A_{r+1}) = ℓ(A_r) + ℓ(B_{r+1})`. -/
theorem step_4_9_additivity {R : Type*} [Ring R] {A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ : Type v}
    [AddCommGroup A₀] [Module R A₀] [AddCommGroup A₁] [Module R A₁]
    [AddCommGroup B₀] [Module R B₀] [AddCommGroup B₁] [Module R B₁]
    (d : A₀ →ₗ[R] B₀) (es : A₁ ≃ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker d)
    (et : B₁ ≃ₗ[R] B₀ ⧸ LinearMap.range d) :
    Module.length R B₀ + Module.length R A₁ = Module.length R A₀ + Module.length R B₁ := by
  have hsource : Module.length R A₀ =
      Module.length R (LinearMap.ker d) + Module.length R (LinearMap.range d) :=
    (definition_4_6 (T := R) (M := A₀)).2 (LinearMap.ker d).subtype d.rangeRestrict
      (Submodule.subtype_injective _)
      (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp (LinearMap.range_rangeRestrict d))
      (by rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, Submodule.range_subtype, LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict])
  have htarget : Module.length R B₀ =
      Module.length R (LinearMap.range d) + Module.length R (B₀ ⧸ LinearMap.range d) :=
    (definition_4_6 (T := R) (M := B₀)).2 (LinearMap.range d).subtype (LinearMap.range d).mkQ
      (Submodule.subtype_injective _) (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
      (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ _)
  rw [es.length_eq, et.length_eq, hsource, htarget]
  ac_rfl

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_exhau.doc:
**Exhaustion: `(B_R)_𝔮 = 0` for some `R`.**  The maps `B_1 → B_r` are onto with
increasing kernels `K_r`.  A homogeneous class `z ∈ G^p` of `B_1` has a preimage
`z = wx₁` (Proposition 4.3) with `w ∈ G^s`, so `z` vanishes in `B_r` once
`p − r + 1 ≤ s`; hence `⋃ K_r = (B_1)_𝔮`.  As `(B_1)_𝔮` is Noetherian the chain
stabilizes at some `K_R = (B_1)_𝔮`, and `(B_R)_𝔮 = 0`.

  {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d)
  (S : Submonoid (Tangential k n))
  [IsNoetherian (Localization S)
      (LocalizedModule S
        ((Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.complex k n N d ⋯).TargetTotal 1))] :
  ∃ R,
    Subsingleton
      (LocalizedModule S
        ((Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.complex k n N d ⋯).TargetTotal (R + 1)))
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_exhau.source:
/-- **Exhaustion: `(B_R)_𝔮 = 0` for some `R`.**  The maps `B_1 → B_r` are onto with
increasing kernels `K_r`.  A homogeneous class `z ∈ G^p` of `B_1` has a preimage
`z = wx₁` (Proposition 4.3) with `w ∈ G^s`, so `z` vanishes in `B_r` once
`p − r + 1 ≤ s`; hence `⋃ K_r = (B_1)_𝔮`.  As `(B_1)_𝔮` is Noetherian the chain
stabilizes at some `K_R = (B_1)_𝔮`, and `(B_R)_𝔮 = 0`. -/
theorem step_4_9_exhaustion (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d)
    (S : Submonoid (Tangential k n))
    [IsNoetherian (Localization S) (LocalizedModule S
      ((complex k n N d (isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm k hform)).TargetTotal 1))] :
    ∃ R, Subsingleton (LocalizedModule S
      ((complex k n N d (isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm k hform)).TargetTotal (R + 1))) :=
  let hd := isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm k hform
  AlgebraicAnalysis.exists_uniform_subsingleton_localized S
    (fun r => tangentialBoundaryMap k n N d hd r)
    (tangentialBoundaryMap_ker_mono k n N d hd)
    (fun z => (complex k n N d hd).totalBoundaryMap_eventually_zero
      (canonicalOrderFiltration_exhaustive k _) (step_4_9_f_surjective hform) z)
    (fun r => tangentialBoundaryMap_surjective k n N d hd r)

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_f_sur.doc:
`f : Q → Q` of the filtered complex is onto: this is `Q = Qx₁`
(Proposition 4.3).
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_f_sur.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_f_surjective.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [Algebra ℚ k]
  {n N : ℕ} {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
  (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
  Function.Surjective ⇑(Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.complex k n N d ⋯).f
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_f_sur.source:
/-- `f : Q → Q` of the filtered complex is onto: this is `Q = Qx₁`
(Proposition 4.3). -/
theorem step_4_9_f_surjective (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
    Function.Surjective (complex k n N d (isPBWMonicAt_of_isMonicNormalForm k hform)).f := by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (rightIdealKSubmodule k (presentedCanonicalRightIdeal (k := k) n N d)) q
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := proposition_4_3 hform (qmk (presentedCanonicalRightIdeal (k := k) n N d) z)
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (rightIdealKSubmodule k (presentedCanonicalRightIdeal (k := k) n N d)) y
  rw [← hy'] at hy
  refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk y', ?_⟩
  change rightMulLinearMap k (presentedCanonicalRightIdeal (k := k) n N d)
      (presentedCoordinate k n) (Submodule.Quotient.mk y') = Submodule.Quotient.mk z
  rw [rightMulLinearMap_mk]
  exact hy

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_pages.doc:
**The pages and their `T`-structure.**  `A_{r+1} = ker d_r` and
`B_{r+1} = coker d_r`, `T`-linearly, and `A_1 ≅ V`, `B_1 ≅ U`.  The `T`-action on
the pages comes from the symbols of the transverse generators, whose commutators
lower the filtration (`generator_commutator_lowers`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_pages.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_pages.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [Algebra ℚ k] {n N : ℕ}
  {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
  (hd : WeylPBWMonicBridge.IsPBWMonicAt k (Sum.inr 0) N d) :
  (∀ (r : ℕ),
      Nonempty
        ((Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.complex k n N d hd).SourceTotal
            (r + 1) ≃ₗ[Tangential k n]
          ↥(Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.tangentialDrop k n N d hd r).ker)) ∧
    (∀ (r : ℕ),
        Nonempty
          ((Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.complex k n N d hd).TargetTotal
              (r + 1) ≃ₗ[Tangential k n]
            (Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.complex k n N d hd).TargetTotal r ⧸
              (Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.tangentialDrop k n N d hd r).range)) ∧
      Nonempty
          ((Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.complex k n N d hd).SourceTotal
              1 ≃ₗ[Tangential k n]
            ↥(kernelV k n N d)) ∧
        Nonempty
          ((Characteristic.CanonicalTangentialTotalAction.complex k n N d hd).TargetTotal
              1 ≃ₗ[Tangential k n]
            cokernelU k n N d)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_pages.source:
/-- **The pages and their `T`-structure.**  `A_{r+1} = ker d_r` and
`B_{r+1} = coker d_r`, `T`-linearly, and `A_1 ≅ V`, `B_1 ≅ U`.  The `T`-action on
the pages comes from the symbols of the transverse generators, whose commutators
lower the filtration (`generator_commutator_lowers`). -/
theorem step_4_9_pages (hd : IsPBWMonicAt k (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1))) N d) :
    (∀ r, Nonempty ((complex k n N d hd).SourceTotal (r + 1) ≃ₗ[Tangential k n]
        LinearMap.ker (tangentialDrop k n N d hd r))) ∧
      (∀ r, Nonempty ((complex k n N d hd).TargetTotal (r + 1) ≃ₗ[Tangential k n]
        ((complex k n N d hd).TargetTotal r ⧸ LinearMap.range (tangentialDrop k n N d hd r)))) ∧
      Nonempty ((complex k n N d hd).SourceTotal 1 ≃ₗ[Tangential k n] kernelV k n N d) ∧
      Nonempty ((complex k n N d hd).TargetTotal 1 ≃ₗ[Tangential k n] cokernelU k n N d) :=
  ⟨fun r => ⟨tangentialSourceSuccEquiv k n N d hd r⟩,
    fun r => ⟨tangentialTargetSuccEquiv k n N d hd r⟩,
    ⟨firstSourceGradedKernelEquiv k n N d hd⟩, ⟨firstTargetGradedCokernelEquiv k n N d hd⟩⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_pages.doc:
**Later pages have finite length.**  `A_{r+1} ⊆ A_r` and `B_{r+1}` is a
quotient of `B_r`, so finite length of `A_1, B_1` passes to all `r ≥ 1`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_pages.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_pages_finite_length.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {R : Type u_1} [Ring R]
  {A : ℕ → Type u_2} {B : ℕ → Type u_3} [(r : ℕ) → AddCommGroup (A r)] [(r : ℕ) → Module R (A r)]
  [(r : ℕ) → AddCommGroup (B r)] [(r : ℕ) → Module R (B r)] (d : (r : ℕ) → A r →ₗ[R] B r)
  (sourceSucc : (r : ℕ) → A (r + 1) ≃ₗ[R] ↥(d r).ker)
  (targetSucc : (r : ℕ) → B (r + 1) ≃ₗ[R] B r ⧸ (d r).range) (hA1 : IsFiniteLength R (A 1))
  (hB1 : IsFiniteLength R (B 1)) (r : ℕ) : 1 ≤ r → IsFiniteLength R (A r) ∧ IsFiniteLength R (B r)
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_pages.source:
/-- **Later pages have finite length.**  `A_{r+1} ⊆ A_r` and `B_{r+1}` is a
quotient of `B_r`, so finite length of `A_1, B_1` passes to all `r ≥ 1`. -/
theorem step_4_9_pages_finite_length
    (d : ∀ r, A r →ₗ[R] B r)
    (sourceSucc : ∀ r, A (r + 1) ≃ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker (d r))
    (targetSucc : ∀ r, B (r + 1) ≃ₗ[R] B r ⧸ LinearMap.range (d r))
    (hA1 : IsFiniteLength R (A 1)) (hB1 : IsFiniteLength R (B 1)) :
    ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → IsFiniteLength R (A r) ∧ IsFiniteLength R (B r) := by
  intro r hr
  induction r, hr using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact ⟨hA1, hB1⟩
  | succ r _ ih =>
      exact ⟨(sourceSucc r).symm.isFiniteLength
          (IsFiniteLength.of_injective ih.1 (Submodule.subtype_injective _)),
        (targetSucc r).symm.isFiniteLength
          (IsFiniteLength.of_surjective ih.2 (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _))⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_teles.doc:
**Summing (additivity) over `r = 1,…,R−1`.**  The intermediate terms cancel:
`ℓ(B_1) + ℓ(A_R) = ℓ(A_1) + ℓ(B_R)`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_teles.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_telescope (a b : ℕ → ℕ∞) (ha : ∀ (r : ℕ), a r ≠ ⊤)
  (hb : ∀ (r : ℕ), b r ≠ ⊤) (hadd : ∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → b r + a (r + 1) = a r + b (r + 1)) (R : ℕ) :
  1 ≤ R → b 1 + a R = a 1 + b R
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_4_9_teles.source:
/-- **Summing (additivity) over `r = 1,…,R−1`.**  The intermediate terms cancel:
`ℓ(B_1) + ℓ(A_R) = ℓ(A_1) + ℓ(B_R)`. -/
theorem step_4_9_telescope (a b : ℕ → ℕ∞) (ha : ∀ r, a r ≠ ⊤) (hb : ∀ r, b r ≠ ⊤)
    (hadd : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → b r + a (r + 1) = a r + b (r + 1)) :
    ∀ R, 1 ≤ R → b 1 + a R = a 1 + b R := by
  have ha' : ∀ r, a r = ((a r).toNat : ℕ∞) := fun r => (ENat.natCast_toNat (ha r)).symm
  have hb' : ∀ r, b r = ((b r).toNat : ℕ∞) := fun r => (ENat.natCast_toNat (hb r)).symm
  have hadd' : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → (b r).toNat + (a (r + 1)).toNat = (a r).toNat + (b (r + 1)).toNat :=
    fun r hr => by
      have h := hadd r hr
      rw [ha' r, ha' (r + 1), hb' r, hb' (r + 1)] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
  intro R hR
  rw [ha' 1, ha' R, hb' 1, hb' R]
  norm_cast
  induction R, hR using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact add_comm _ _
  | succ R hR ih =>
      have h := hadd' R hR
      omega

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_coordinat.doc:
**Normality of `x₁` in `A_{≥0}`.**  `x₁` commutes with the transverse
algebra, so for every `r ∈ A_{≥0}` there is `r' ∈ A_{≥0}` with `x₁ r = r' x₁`.
Only this one-sided normality is used later.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_coordinat.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_coordinate_normal.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} [Ring A] (C : Subring A)
  (x p : A) (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1) (hcomm : ∀ (c : ↥C), x * ↑c = ↑c * x) (r : A) :
  r ∈ nonnegativePart C x p → ∃ r' ∈ nonnegativePart C x p, x * r = r' * x
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_coordinat.source:
/-- **Normality of `x₁` in `A_{≥0}`.**  `x₁` commutes with the transverse
algebra, so for every `r ∈ A_{≥0}` there is `r' ∈ A_{≥0}` with `x₁ r = r' x₁`.
Only this one-sided normality is used later. -/
theorem step_coordinate_normal (C : Subring A) (x p : A)
    (hweyl : p * x = x * p + 1)
    (hcomm : ∀ c : C, x * (c : A) = (c : A) * x) :
    ∀ r ∈ nonnegativePart C x p, ∃ r' ∈ nonnegativePart C x p, x * r = r' * x := by
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := coordinate_normal_eulerSubring C x p hweyl hcomm ⟨r, hr⟩
  exact ⟨s, s.property, hs⟩
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.step_coordinat.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring A] (C : Subring A) (x p : A),
  p * x = x * p + 1 →
    (∀ (c : ↥C), x * ↑c = ↑c * x) →
      ∀ r ∈ Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {x, x * p}),
        ∃ r' ∈ Subring.closure (↑C ∪ {x, x * p}), x * r = r' * x

Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1.doc:
**Theorem 1.1.** For every field `k` of characteristic zero, every `n ≥ 0`
and every nonzero `d ∈ A_n(k)` there is `F ∈ A_n(k)` with
`A_n(k) = dA_n(k) + FdA_n(k)`, i.e. `1 = dR + FdS` for some `R, S`.
Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1.source:
/-- **Theorem 1.1.** For every field `k` of characteristic zero, every `n ≥ 0`
and every nonzero `d ∈ A_n(k)` there is `F ∈ A_n(k)` with
`A_n(k) = dA_n(k) + FdA_n(k)`, i.e. `1 = dR + FdS` for some `R, S`. -/
theorem theorem_1_1 : Stafford38Challenge.UniversalStatement.{u} :=
  Section6.theorem_1_1_paper
Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1.unfolded:
∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
  (d :
    RingQuot fun a b =>
      ∃ i j,
        a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
          b = (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))) (Matrix.J (Fin n) k i j)),
  d ≠ 0 → ∃ F R S, 1 = d * R + F * d * S

for a linear symplectic coordinate `ℓ = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)`.

for a linear symplectic coordinate `ℓ = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)`. -/

    Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.UniversalFixedSourceStatement.{u} :=
  Section6.theorem_1_1_fixedSource_paper
Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1_fixedSource.unfolded:
∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
  (d :
    RingQuot fun a b =>
      ∃ i j,
        a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
          b =
            (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)),
  d ≠ 0 →
    ∃ ell R S,
      (∃ M N,
          ∃ (_ : M * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * M.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ :
            N * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * N.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ : M * N = 1)
            (_ : N * M = 1),
            ell =
              ∑ j,
                (algebraMap k
                      (RingQuot fun a b =>
                        ∃ i j,
                          a =
                              FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                            b =
                              (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)))
                    (N (Sum.inl 0) j) *
                  (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                      ∃ i j,
                        a =
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                              FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                          b =
                            (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                    (FreeAlgebra.ι k j)) ∧
        1 =
          d * R +
            ell ^
                  sInf
                    {N |
                      d ∈
                        Submodule.span k
                          {z |
                            ∃ a p,
                              ∑ i, a i + ∑ i, p i ≤ N ∧
                                z =
                                  (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                                      ∃ i j,
                                        a =
                                            FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                              FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                                          b =
                                            (algebraMap k
                                                (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                                    (Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x =>
                                      (Fin x → ℕ) → (Fin x → ℕ) → FreeAlgebra k (Fin x ⊕ Fin x))
                                      (n + 1)
                                      (fun x f x_1 x_2 =>
                                        Nat.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
                                          (Fin x → ℕ) →
                                            (Fin x → ℕ) →
                                              Nat.below (motive := fun x =>
                                                  (Fin x → ℕ) →
                                                    (Fin x → ℕ) → FreeAlgebra k (Fin x ⊕ Fin x))
                                                  x →
                                                FreeAlgebra k (Fin x ⊕ Fin x))
                                          x (fun x x_3 x_4 => 1)
                                          (fun n x x_3 x_4 =>
                                            ((FreeAlgebra.lift k) fun i =>
                                                    FreeAlgebra.ι k
                                                      (Sum.casesOn i (fun val => Sum.inl val.succ)
                                                        fun val => Sum.inr val.succ))
                                                  (x_4.1 (fun i => x i.succ) fun i => x_3 i.succ) *
                                                FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl 0) ^ x 0 *
                                              FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr 0) ^ x_3 0)
                                          x_1 x_2 f)
                                      a p)}} *
                d *
              S

Stafford38.TorsionCyclicity.IsRightTorsi.doc: Every element of a right module is killed by some nonzero right scalar.
Stafford38.TorsionCyclicity.IsRightTorsi.signature:
Stafford38.TorsionCyclicity.IsRightTorsion.{u, v} {A : Type u} {M : Type v} [Ring A]
  [AddCommGroup M] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ M] : Prop
Stafford38.TorsionCyclicity.IsRightTorsi.source:
/-- Every element of a right module is killed by some nonzero right scalar. -/
def IsRightTorsion {A : Type u} {M : Type v} [Ring A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ M] : Prop :=
  ∀ m : M, ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ (MulOpposite.op d : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • m = 0

/-- A source coordinate obtained from an invertible symplectic linear change
of the canonical Weyl generators. -/
def IsLinearWeylCoordinate (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (ell : WeylAlg k (n + 1)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (M N : Matrix (PhaseVar (n + 1)) (PhaseVar (n + 1)) k)
      (_hM : M * standardForm k (n + 1) * Matrix.transpose M =
        standardForm k (n + 1))
      (_hN : N * standardForm k (n + 1) * Matrix.transpose N =
        standardForm k (n + 1))
      (_hMN : M * N = 1) (_hNM : N * M = 1),
      ell = linearCombination k N (generator k (n + 1))
        (.inl (0 : Fin (n + 1)))

/-- Shared template for the fixed-source proposition, parameterized only by
the chosen degree function. -/
def UniversalFixedSourceStatementWithDegree
    (degree : ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] {n : ℕ}, WeylAlg k n → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
    (d : WeylAlg k (n + 1)), d ≠ 0 →
      ∃ ell R S : WeylAlg k (n + 1),
        IsLinearWeylCoordinate k n ell ∧
          (1 : WeylAlg k (n + 1)) =
            d * R + ell ^ degree k d * d * S

    (fun r => if 1 ≤ r then Module.length (Localization S) (A r) else 0)
    (fun r => if 1 ≤ r then Module.length (Localization S) (B r) else 0)
    (fun r => by
      split_ifs with h
      · exact Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr (hfl r h).1
      · exact ENat.zero_ne_top)
    (fun r => by
      split_ifs with h
      · exact Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr (hfl r h).2
      · exact ENat.zero_ne_top)
    (fun r hr => by
      simp only [hr, ite_true, show 1 ≤ r + 1 by omega]
      exact step_4_9_additivity (dd r) (es r) (et r))
    (R' + 1) (by omega)
